definition_en: enjoyable activity that refreshes the mind or body; the restoring of health; the act of creating again
core_image: 公园长椅上的人放下工作，笑着望向湖面
scene: 周末的公园里，有人骑车，有人铺开野餐布。Gardening is his favourite form of recreation.
sceneCN: 这里 recreation 是「消遣」（第 1 个义项：让人放松的娱乐活动）；句意为园艺是他最喜欢的消遣。画面里可留意：骑车的人、铺开的野餐布。

senses.title: Enjoyable activity
senses.definition: an activity done for enjoyment that refreshes the mind or body
senses.definitionCN: 为获得乐趣、使身心恢复而做的事
senses.example: Gardening is his favourite form of recreation.
senses.exampleCN: 园艺是他最喜欢的消遣。
senses.why: Recreare meant to restore, and the noun first named the restoring of health before it named the games that do the restoring.
senses.whyCN: recreare 意为恢复，这个名词先指恢复健康，后来才指带来恢复的娱乐活动。

senses.title: The restoring of strength
senses.definition: the act of recovering strength and health after work or illness
senses.definitionCN: 在工作或生病之后恢复体力与健康的行为
senses.example: He walked by the sea for recreation after the illness.
senses.exampleCN: 病后他在海边散步休养。
senses.why: The older sense is recovery, and a walk taken to restore the body keeps that meaning alive.
senses.whyCN: 较早的意思是恢复，而为了调养身体所走的散步，正是这层含义的延续。

senses.title: The act of creating again
senses.definition: the act of making something again or of reproducing a scene or an event
senses.definitionCN: 重新制作某物，或再现某个场景与事件
senses.example: The film is a recreation of the battle rather than a record.
senses.exampleCN: 这部影片是对那场战役的再现，而不是记录。
senses.why: When re- is read as again and create as to make, the word can literally mean a second making.
senses.whyCN: 当 re- 被读作「再次」、create 被读作「制作」时，这个词就可以字面地表示「第二次制作」。

intro.en: Recreation begins as restoration: the body is made fresh again, and the activities that do this take the name.
intro.cn: recreation 始于「恢复」：身体被重新造得清新，而带来这种效果的活动便沿用了这个名字。

items.en: Creare meant to create, produce, or bring forth, the root of the family.
items.cn: creare 意为创造、产生或带来，是整个词族的词根。

items.en: Recreare joined re-, again, to creare and meant to restore or refresh.
items.cn: recreare 由 re-（再次）与 creare 组成，意为恢复或使清新。

items.en: Old French recreacion carried the noun into English as refreshment.
items.cn: 古法语 recreacion 把这个名词带入英语，意为恢复精神。

items.en: English first used recreation for the restoring of health after labour.
items.cn: 英语最初用 recreation 指劳作之后的恢复。

items.en: Modern English widened the word to the games and hobbies that refresh people.
items.cn: 现代英语把这个词扩展到使人恢复的游戏与爱好。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers nouns from the same create family; the near-meaning group gathers words for leisure and amusement.
note.cn: 形近组收同一 create 词族的名词；近义组收表休闲与娱乐的词。

entries.definition: The act of making something new.
The act of making something again.
A hobby that passes the time pleasantly.

normalIntro.en: The word is creating again: energy that was used up is made fresh, and the activity that does it is called recreation.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是「重新创造」：耗掉的精力被重新造出，而做这件事的活动就叫 recreation。

normal.en: Re plus creation: a second making, this time of your own strength.
normal.cn: re 加 creation：第二次创造，这次造的是你自己的精力。

normal.en: Outdoor recreation means games played in the open air.
normal.cn: outdoor recreation 指在户外进行的活动。

normal.en: A recreation centre is a building for leisure activities.
normal.cn: recreation centre 是供休闲活动的场所。

normal.en: Recreation and re-creation differ by a hyphen and by their meaning.
normal.cn: recreation 与 re-creation 只差一个连字符，意思却不同。

normal.en: The noun is uncountable when it means leisure, countable when it means a re-enactment.
normal.cn: 表休闲时不可数，表「再现」时可数。

abstract.en: Recreation is the art of making the self fresh again.
abstract.cn: 消遣是让自我重新清新的艺术。

abstract.en: What restores a person is not idleness but a different kind of effort.
abstract.cn: 让人恢复的不是闲散，而是另一种努力。

abstract.en: A society shows its values in what it chooses to do for recreation.
abstract.cn: 一个社会选择以什么为消遣，就显露出它的价值。

examples.en: Gardening is his favourite form of recreation.
examples.cn: 园艺是他最喜欢的消遣。

examples.en: He walked by the sea for recreation after the illness.
examples.cn: 病后他在海边散步休养。

examples.en: The film is a recreation of the battle rather than a record.
examples.cn: 这部影片是对那场战役的再现，而不是记录。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（重新）加 create（创造）：把耗掉的精力重新造回来，就是休养；用来休养的活动，就是消遣。

root: 拉丁 creare（创造）→ recreare（恢复、重新振作）→ 古法语 recreacion → 英语 recreation；同族有 recreational、recreate。

sensesIntro.en: The core is restoration; the senses move from restoring health to the activities that restore it and to a second making of a scene.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「恢复」；义项从恢复健康，到带来恢复的活动，再到对场景的再次制作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a park bench where someone sets down their work and smiles at the lake.
core.cn: 核心意象：公园长椅上的人放下工作，笑着望向湖面。

branches.en: a picnic blanket on grass
a slow walk by the sea
a film set rebuilding a battle
a game and the strength it restores
a body remade and a scene remade
branches.cn: 身体被重建，场景也被重建

intro.en: A Latin verb of creating takes a prefix of repetition and a noun ending, and the result names both rest and re-enactment.
intro.cn: 拉丁语的「创造」动词接上表重复的前缀与名词词尾，结果既指休息，也指再现。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is creare, to create, changed by re- and named by -tio.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 creare（创造），由 re- 加以改变，并由 -tio 名词化。

definition_zh: 娱乐的；休闲的；消遣用的
definition_en: relating to recreation; used for leisure; taken for pleasure rather than medical need
core_image: 湖边一排彩色的脚踏船和自行车
scene: 湖边租船处排着一排彩色的脚踏船，孩子们在挑颜色。The town opened a new recreational area beside the lake.
sceneCN: 这里 recreational 是「休闲的」（第 2 个义项：供休闲使用的）；句意为小镇在湖边新开了一片休闲区。画面里可留意：彩色的脚踏船、挑颜色的孩子。

pos.zh: 娱乐的；休闲的；消遣用的

senses.title: Relating to enjoyable activity
senses.definition: connected with activities done for enjoyment
senses.definitionCN: 与为乐趣而做的活动有关
senses.example: Swimming is a recreational sport for most people.
senses.exampleCN: 对大多数人来说，游泳是一项娱乐性运动。
senses.why: The adjective simply attaches the noun recreation to whatever serves it, so any game played for fun is recreational.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词只是把名词 recreation 连接到为它服务的事物上，因此任何为乐趣而玩的游戏都是 recreational。

senses.title: Used for leisure
senses.definition: built or set aside for leisure rather than work
senses.definitionCN: 为休闲而非工作而建造或留出的
senses.example: The town opened a new recreational area beside the lake.
senses.exampleCN: 小镇在湖边新开了一片休闲区。
senses.why: A place marked off for pleasure takes the adjective, because its purpose is the restoring of people.
senses.whyCN: 一块为快乐而划出的地方会带上这个形容词，因为它的目的是让人恢复。

senses.title: Taken for pleasure
senses.definition: used for enjoyment rather than for medical treatment
senses.definitionCN: 为享乐而非治疗而使用
senses.example: The law separates recreational use from medical use.
senses.exampleCN: 法律把消遣性使用与医疗使用区分开来。
senses.why: When a substance is taken for pleasure rather than health, the same adjective marks the difference.
senses.whyCN: 当某种物质是为快乐而非健康而使用时，正是同一个形容词标记出这一区别。

intro.en: Recreational is the noun of leisure with an adjective ending: everything that serves refreshment takes the label.
intro.cn: recreational 是表休闲的名词加形容词词尾：一切为恢复服务的事物都带上这个标签。

items.en: Creare meant to create or produce, the root of the family.
items.cn: creare 意为创造或产生，是词族的词根。

items.en: Recreare meant to restore or refresh a tired body.
items.cn: recreare 意为恢复或使疲惫的身体清新。

items.en: English recreation named both restoration and leisure activity.
items.cn: 英语 recreation 既指恢复，也指休闲活动。

items.en: The suffix -al means relating to, giving recreational.
items.cn: 后缀 -al 意为「与……有关的」，由此构成 recreational。

items.en: Modern English applies the adjective to places, sports, and casual drug use.
items.cn: 现代英语把这个形容词用于场所、运动与消遣性用药。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers adjectives with similar endings; the near-meaning group gathers words of leisure and pleasure.
note.cn: 形近组收结尾相似的形容词；近义组收表休闲与乐趣的词。

normalIntro.en: The word is recreation plus al: anything that serves leisure carries the label.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是 recreation 加 al：凡为休闲服务的事物，都带上这个标签。

normal.en: Recreation plus -al: relating to leisure.
normal.cn: recreation 加 -al：与休闲有关。

normal.en: A recreational area is land set aside for play.
normal.cn: recreational area 是为玩乐留出的地方。

normal.en: Recreational facilities include pools, courts, and trails.
normal.cn: recreational facilities 包括泳池、球场与步道。

normal.en: The stress stays on the third syllable, as in recreation.
normal.cn: 重音仍在第三音节，与 recreation 一致。

normal.en: Recreational use of a drug means use for pleasure, not treatment.
normal.cn: 药物的 recreational use 指为享乐而非治疗而使用。

abstract.en: A recreational space is a city admitting that people need more than work.
abstract.cn: 休闲空间，是一座城市承认人需要的不仅是工作。

abstract.en: Play labelled recreational is play that society permits itself.
abstract.cn: 被标为休闲的玩乐，是社会允许自己拥有的玩乐。

abstract.en: The adjective turns pleasure into a category of planning.
abstract.cn: 这个形容词把快乐变成了规划中的一个类别。

examples.en: Swimming is a recreational sport for most people.
examples.cn: 对大多数人来说，游泳是一项娱乐性运动。

examples.en: The town opened a new recreational area beside the lake.
examples.cn: 小镇在湖边新开了一片休闲区。

examples.en: The law separates recreational use from medical use.
examples.cn: 法律把消遣性使用与医疗使用区分开来。

dict_mnemonic.text: recreation（消遣）加 al（……的）：与消遣有关的，就是 recreational——娱乐的、休闲的。

root: recreation（消遣）+ 后缀 -al（……的）→ recreational；recreation 源自拉丁 recreare；同族有 recreationally。

sensesIntro.en: The core is serving refreshment; the senses move from enjoyable activity to leisure places and to pleasure use.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「为恢复服务」；义项从娱乐活动，到休闲场所，再到消遣性使用。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a row of bright paddle boats waiting at a lakeside jetty.
core.cn: 核心意象：湖边码头旁排着一排色彩鲜亮的脚踏船。

branches.en: a swimmer in a public pool
a new park by the lake
a pleasure taken without a prescription
a game and a place built for it
branches.cn: 游戏与为它建造的场所

branches.en: a leisure area and a leisure choice

intro.en: A noun of leisure takes a Latin adjective ending, and the adjective spreads from sports to places to casual use.
intro.cn: 一个表休闲的名词接上拉丁形容词词尾，这个形容词便从运动扩展到场所，再到消遣性使用。

latinIntro.en: The base is recreare, to refresh, and the ending -al marks a relation.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 recreare（使恢复），词尾 -al 标记关联。

definition_en: to enlist new soldiers or members; to take someone into a company or team; a newly enlisted person
core_image: 军营门口排起长队，年轻人在登记表上写下名字
scene: 军营门口排起长队，年轻人把名字写进登记表。The army began to recruit soldiers from the surrounding villages.
sceneCN: 这里 recruit 是「招募」（第 1 个义项：征募新兵）；句意为军队开始从周边村庄招募士兵。画面里可留意：门口的长队、写名字的登记表。

senses.title: To enlist soldiers
senses.definition: to persuade people to join an army or a fighting force
senses.definitionCN: 说服人们加入军队或武装力量
senses.example: The army began to recruit soldiers from the surrounding villages.
senses.exampleCN: 军队开始从周边村庄招募士兵。
senses.why: The Latin root meant to grow again, and a recruit is new growth added to an army that needs more men.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为「再次生长」，而新兵就是为一支缺人的军队补充的新生力量。

senses.title: To take someone into a team
senses.definition: to bring a person into a company, a club, or a sports team
senses.definitionCN: 把某人招进公司、俱乐部或运动队
senses.example: The firm recruited three engineers this spring.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司今年春天招了三名工程师。
senses.why: The military sense widened to any group that adds members, because every team also needs new growth.
senses.whyCN: 军事义扩展到任何补充成员的团体，因为每个团队也都需要新的生长。

senses.title: A newly enlisted person
senses.definition: a person who has just joined an army, a company, or a team
senses.definitionCN: 刚加入军队、公司或团队的人
senses.example: The new recruits trained for six weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 新兵们训练了六周。
senses.why: The noun names the new growth itself, the person who has just been added to the body.
senses.whyCN: 名词指「新生力量」本身，也就是刚被加入集体的人。

intro.en: Recruit is about growth: an army that needs men is made to grow again, and the new men are the growth.
intro.cn: recruit 讲的是生长：缺人的军队被重新养大，而新人就是那份生长。

items.en: Crescere meant to grow, the root behind the whole family.
items.cn: crescere 意为生长，是整个词族的词根。

items.en: Recrescere meant to grow again, to increase after a loss.
items.cn: recrescere 意为再次生长，在损失之后重新增加。

items.en: French recrute named a new growth of troops, a fresh supply of soldiers.
items.cn: 法语 recrute 指军队的新生力量，即新补充的兵员。

items.en: English recruit first meant to repair an army by adding men.
items.cn: 英语 recruit 最初指通过补充人员来修复军队。

items.en: Modern English extended the verb to hiring in companies and clubs.
items.cn: 现代英语把这个动词扩展到公司与俱乐部的招聘。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers short verbs beginning with re-; the near-meaning group gathers words for enlisting and newcomers.
note.cn: 形近组收以 re- 开头的短动词；近义组收表征募与新来者的词。

entries.definition: To tell a story in detail.
To join or sign up an army.
A person who has just arrived.

normalIntro.en: The word is growing again: an army short of men is made to grow, and the men are the growth.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是「再次生长」：缺人的军队被重新养大，而新人就是那份生长。

normal.en: Re plus cruit: grow the force again, and you recruit.
normal.cn: re 加 cruit：让队伍再次生长，就是招募。

normal.en: A new recruit is the person added, not the act of adding.
normal.cn: new recruit 指被加入的人，而不是加入的行为。

normal.en: Recruit staff is the business use; recruit soldiers is the military one.
normal.cn: recruit staff 是商业用法，recruit soldiers 是军事用法。

normal.en: Recruited is the past form: recruit, recruited, recruiting.
normal.cn: 过去式是 recruited：recruit、recruited、recruiting。

normal.en: A recruiter is the person who does the recruiting.
normal.cn: recruiter 是做招募这件事的人。

abstract.en: Every group that survives knows how to grow again.
abstract.cn: 每一个能存续的团体，都懂得如何再次生长。

abstract.en: A recruit brings energy that the old members have used up.
abstract.cn: 新人带来的是老成员已经耗尽的能量。

abstract.en: To recruit is to bet that a stranger will become one of us.
abstract.cn: 招募，就是赌一个陌生人会成为我们中的一员。

examples.en: The army began to recruit soldiers from the surrounding villages.
examples.cn: 军队开始从周边村庄招募士兵。

examples.en: The firm recruited three engineers this spring.
examples.cn: 这家公司今年春天招了三名工程师。

examples.en: The new recruits trained for six weeks.
examples.cn: 新兵们训练了六周。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（再）加 cruit（生长）：让队伍再长出新人，就是招募；被招来的人就是新兵。

root: 拉丁 crescere（生长）→ recrescere（再生长）→ 法语 recrute → 英语 recruit；同族有 recruitment、recruiter。

sensesIntro.en: The core is new growth added to a group; the senses move from enlisting soldiers to hiring members and to the person added.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「为团体补充的新生力量」；义项从征募士兵，到招收成员，再到被加入的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a queue at a barracks gate, names written on a list.
core.cn: 核心意象：军营门口排起长队，名字被写进名册。

branches.en: a queue at a barracks gate
three desks filled at a company
branches.cn: 公司里坐满的三张桌子

branches.en: a line of new soldiers training
an army and an office both growing
hiring and then training

intro.en: A Latin verb of growing takes a prefix of repetition, passes through French, and then covers armies and offices.
intro.cn: 一个表生长的拉丁动词接上表重复的前缀，经法语传来，随后覆盖军队与公司。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is crescere, to grow, strengthened by re- into recrescere.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 crescere（生长），由 re- 加强为 recrescere。

definition_en: the colour of blood; a red wine; a state of financial loss
core_image: 一面红旗在灰白的街道上格外显眼
scene: 灰白的街道尽头，一面红旗被风吹得鼓起来。She wore a red coat and walked quickly through the crowd.
sceneCN: 这里 red 是「红色」（第 1 个义项：血一样的颜色）；句意为她穿着红色外套，快步穿过人群。画面里可留意：被风吹鼓的红旗、人群中的红色外套。

senses.title: The colour of blood
senses.definition: the colour seen in blood, fire, and ripe fruit
senses.definitionCN: 血液、火焰与成熟果实所呈现的颜色
senses.example: She wore a red coat and walked quickly through the crowd.
senses.exampleCN: 她穿着红色外套，快步穿过人群。
senses.why: Old English read named the colour directly, and the word has stayed basic and concrete ever since.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 rēad 直接命名这种颜色，这个词从此一直是最基础、最具体的词。

senses.title: A red wine
senses.definition: a wine made from dark grapes and served as a drink
senses.definitionCN: 用深色葡萄酿成、作为饮品供应的酒
senses.example: He ordered a glass of red to go with the meat.
senses.exampleCN: 他点了一杯红葡萄酒配肉。
senses.why: The colour of the wine became a short name for the drink, so a glass of red is a glass of red wine.
senses.whyCN: 酒的颜色成了这种饮品的简称，因此 a glass of red 就是一杯红葡萄酒。

senses.title: A state of loss
senses.definition: the condition of spending more than one earns, shown in red ink in accounts
senses.definitionCN: 支出超过收入的状态，账目上以红字表示
senses.example: The company has been in the red for three quarters.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司已经连续三个季度亏损。
senses.why: Accountants once wrote losses in red ink, so being in the red came to mean losing money.
senses.whyCN: 会计曾用红墨水记录亏损，因此 in the red 逐渐表示亏钱。

intro.en: Red is one of the oldest colour words in English, inherited rather than borrowed, and its later senses grew from things that are red.
intro.cn: red 是英语中最古老的颜色词之一，属继承而来而非借用，后来的义项都从「红的事物」生长出来。

items.en: Read was the Old English adjective for the colour of blood.
items.cn: rēad 是古英语中表血色的形容词。

items.en: The word belongs to a Germanic family with Dutch rood and German rot.
items.cn: 这个词属于日耳曼语族，同族有荷兰语 rood 与德语 rot。

items.en: All these forms go back to an ancient root meaning red or ruddy.
items.cn: 这些形式都可追溯到意为「红、赤」的古老词根。

items.en: Middle English red simplified the spelling and kept the colour sense.
items.cn: 中古英语 red 简化了拼写，保留了颜色义。

items.en: Modern English extended red to wine, to loss, and to warning signals.
items.cn: 现代英语把 red 扩展到葡萄酒、亏损与警示信号。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers short words that differ by one letter; the near-meaning group gathers shades of red.
note.cn: 形近组收只差一个字母的短词；近义组收各种红色调。

entries.definition: A tall grass growing by water.
A bright red with a hint of orange.
A rich red like the gem.

normalIntro.en: The word is basic and concrete; its later meanings come from red ink, red wine, and red flags.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词基础而具体；后来的含义都来自红墨水、红葡萄酒与红旗。

normal.en: Red is the colour of blood, fire, and ripe fruit.
normal.cn: red 是血、火与成熟果实的颜色。

normal.en: In the red means losing money, because losses were written in red ink.
normal.cn: in the red 意为亏损，因为亏损曾用红墨水记录。

normal.en: A glass of red is a short way to say a glass of red wine.
normal.cn: a glass of red 是「一杯红葡萄酒」的简称。

normal.en: A red flag warns of danger, on a road or in a report.
normal.cn: red flag 在道路或报告中都表示危险信号。

normal.en: The comparison doubles the d: redder, reddest.
normal.cn: 比较级双写 d：redder、reddest。

abstract.en: Red is the colour that demands to be seen before anything else.
abstract.cn: 红色是要求被最先看见的颜色。

abstract.en: Every language gives red to both love and danger.
abstract.cn: 每种语言都把红色同时给了爱与危险。

abstract.en: A number in red is a fact a business cannot ignore.
abstract.cn: 红色的数字，是生意无法忽视的事实。

examples.en: She wore a red coat and walked quickly through the crowd.
examples.cn: 她穿着红色外套，快步穿过人群。

examples.en: He ordered a glass of red to go with the meat.
examples.cn: 他点了一杯红葡萄酒配肉。

examples.en: The company has been in the red for three quarters.
examples.cn: 这家公司已经连续三个季度亏损。

dict_mnemonic.text: red 联想「一面红旗」：最醒目的颜色；账目上的亏损也用红笔记，于是有了 in the red（赤字）。

root: 古英语 rēad（红）→ 中古英语 red → 现代英语 red；同族有 redden、reddish、redness。与拉丁 ruber 同源，但不是借自拉丁语。

sensesIntro.en: The core is the colour of blood; the senses move from the colour to red wine and to red ink in accounts.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「血的颜色」；义项从颜色，到红葡萄酒，再到账目上的红字。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a red flag standing out against a grey street.
core.cn: 核心意象：灰白街道上一面格外显眼的红旗。

chain: A RED FIGURE IN A LEDGER

branches.en: a flag snapping in the wind
a glass of dark wine
a ledger line in red ink
branches.cn: 账本上用红墨水写的一行

branches.en: a colour worn and a colour drunk
branches.cn: 穿在身上的颜色与喝下肚的颜色

branches.en: wine and loss both coded red
branches.cn: 酒与亏损都用红色标记

intro.en: The word is native and short, and its small family is built with English endings for becoming, resembling, and being.
intro.cn: 这个词短小且为本族词，其小词族由表「变成」「相似」与「状态」的英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin source is recorded; Latin ruber is a cognate from the same ancient root, not a borrowing.
latinIntro.cn: 没有可靠的拉丁语来源；拉丁语 ruber 是同源的亲属词，并非借用。

definition_en: to make something smaller in amount or degree; to bring down; to force into a state; to simplify into a basic form
core_image: 鼓胀的行李箱被一点点压到能合上盖子
scene: 出发前一晚，他把行李箱里的衣服一件件拿出来重新叠紧。He had to reduce the weight of his luggage before the flight.
sceneCN: 这里 reduce 是「减少」（第 1 个义项：使数量或程度变小）；句意为他必须在登机前减轻行李的重量。画面里可留意：被重新叠紧的衣物、终于合上的箱盖。

senses.title: To make smaller
senses.definition: to make an amount, size, or degree smaller than it was
senses.definitionCN: 使数量、规模或程度比原来小
senses.example: The factory has reduced its water use by a third.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂把用水量减少了三分之一。
senses.why: The oldest Latin sense was to lead back; English turned the backward pull into a downward one, and lessening became the everyday meaning.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最早的拉丁义是「往回引」；英语把往回拉变成往下压，于是「使变小」成了日常义。

senses.title: To force into a state
senses.definition: to bring someone into a particular condition, especially a weaker or simpler one
senses.definitionCN: 使某人进入某种状态，尤指更弱或更简单的状态
senses.example: The news reduced her to tears in front of the whole class.
senses.exampleCN: 那消息让她在全班面前哭了起来。
senses.why: If a person is led down to tears or silence, the downward movement of the word is felt as a loss of composure.
senses.whyCN: 当一个人被「压」到流泪或沉默，这个词向下运动的意味就表现为失去镇定。

senses.title: To simplify into a basic form
senses.definition: to express something complex in a simpler or more basic form
senses.definitionCN: 把复杂的事物用更简单、更基本的形式表达出来
senses.example: The whole argument can be reduced to one question about money.
senses.exampleCN: 整场争论可以归纳成一个关于钱的问题。
senses.why: Simplifying is a kind of leading back: a tangle of details is brought back to the few points that carry it.
senses.whyCN: 简化也是一种「引回」：把一堆纠缠的细节带回支撑它的少数几点。

intro.en: Reduce first meant to lead back, and only later to make smaller; the modern sense keeps the downward direction of the older movement.
intro.cn: reduce 最初意为「引回」，后来才表示「使变小」；现代义保留了旧有动作中向下的方向。

items.en: Ducere meant to lead or draw, and it built a large family of verbs of motion.
items.cn: ducere 意为引导或拉，它构成了一个庞大的运动动词家族。

items.en: Reducere joined re-, back, with ducere and meant to lead or bring back.
items.cn: reducere 由 re-（往回）与 ducere 组成，意为引回或带回。

items.en: In classical Latin reducere meant to restore or bring a person home, not to lessen.
items.cn: 在古典拉丁语中，reducere 指恢复或把人带回家，并不表示减少。

items.en: English took the word for bringing something down and used it for lowering amounts.
items.cn: 英语借入这个词表示把某物往下带，并用于降低数量。

items.en: The everyday sense today is simply to make smaller, with the older sense surviving in chemical reduction.
items.cn: 今天的日常义就是使变小，较古的意义则保存在化学的「还原」中。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers verbs built on the Latin ducere; the near-meaning group gathers words for making something less.
note.cn: 形近组收由拉丁 ducere 构成的动词；近义组收表示使某物变少的词。

entries.definition: To reach a conclusion by reasoning.
To lower an amount or price.

normalIntro.en: The Latin word is to lead back; English reads the pull as a push downward, so reduce is to bring an amount down.
normalIntro.cn: 这个拉丁词本是「往回引」；英语把这股拉力读成向下的推，所以 reduce 就是把数量压下去。

normal.en: Re plus ducere, back plus lead: to lead something back down.
normal.cn: re 加 ducere，往回加引：把某物往回引下去。

normal.en: Reduce costs means to bring the bill down.
normal.cn: reduce costs 指把账单压下来。

normal.en: Reduce by half is a fall of fifty per cent.
normal.cn: reduce by half 是下降一半。

normal.en: You can be reduced to tears, that is, pushed down to weeping.
normal.cn: be reduced to tears 就是被压到流泪。

normal.en: The noun is reduction, and the adjective reducible marks what can be cut.
normal.cn: 名词是 reduction，形容词 reducible 指能被削减的。

abstract.en: To reduce is to decide which part of a thing is not essential.
abstract.cn: 减少，就是判断一件事物里哪一部分并非必需。

abstract.en: A reduction in noise is often a change in habit, not in machine.
abstract.cn: 噪音的减少常常来自习惯的改变，而不是机器的改变。

abstract.en: What can be reduced to one line was probably understood.
abstract.cn: 能归纳成一句话的东西，多半是真的懂了。

examples.en: The factory has reduced its water use by a third.
examples.cn: 这家工厂把用水量减少了三分之一。

examples.en: The news reduced her to tears in front of the whole class.
examples.cn: 那消息让她在全班面前哭了起来。

examples.en: The whole argument can be reduced to one question about money.
examples.cn: 整场争论可以归纳成一个关于钱的问题。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（往回）加 duce（引导）：把数字往回引，就是往下压、往少里减。

root: 拉丁 ducere（引导）→ reducere（引回、带回）→ 英语 reduce；同族有 reduction、reducible，形近的 deduce、induce、produce 共用 ducere 词根。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a downward pull; the senses move from making an amount smaller, to pushing a person into a state, to bringing a tangle down to a simple form.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「向下拉」；义项从使数量变小，到把人压进某种状态，再到把乱麻归为简单形式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bulging suitcase pressed down until the lid at last closes.
core.cn: 核心意象：鼓胀的行李箱被一点点压到能合上盖子。

branches.en: a lower water bill
tears in a classroom
one question left on the board
a cut that costs someone composure
pushed down and then pared back

intro.en: A Latin verb of leading takes a prefix meaning back, and English bends that backward motion into a downward one.
intro.cn: 拉丁语的「引导」动词接上表「往回」的前缀，英语把这股向后的动作弯成向下的动作。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is ducere, to lead, changed by re- and named by -tio in the noun.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 ducere（引导），由 re- 加以改变，名词则由 -tio 构成。

definition_en: the act of making something smaller; a cut in amount or price; a simplified version of a longer work
core_image: 一张贴着新价签的旧标签，数字被划掉重写
scene: 店门口的促销牌上，原来的价格被一道横线划掉。The owner announced a sharp reduction in the price of winter coats.
sceneCN: 这里 reduction 是「减价」（第 2 个义项：价格的降低）；句意为店主宣布冬季外套大幅降价。画面里可留意：被划掉的原价、旁边写上的新数字。

collocations.phrase: a reduction of ten per cent

senses.title: A lessening in amount
senses.definition: the act or result of making an amount or size smaller
senses.definitionCN: 使数量或规模变小的行为或结果
senses.example: A sharp reduction in staff followed the merger.
senses.exampleCN: 合并之后人手大幅削减。
senses.why: The noun keeps the downward pull of the verb: something has been brought down, and the drop itself is the reduction.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词保留了动词的向下拉力：某物被压低了，而下降这件事本身就是 reduction。

senses.title: A cut in price
senses.definition: a lowering of the price of goods or services
senses.definitionCN: 商品或服务价格的降低
senses.example: The store advertised a reduction of twenty per cent on all winter coats.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店宣传所有冬季外套降价两成。
senses.why: A price that is led down is felt by the buyer as a gain, so the same noun can name a bargain.
senses.whyCN: 被压下去的价格在买家看来是得到好处，于是同一个名词也能指「便宜」。

senses.title: A shortened version
senses.definition: a simplified or shortened form of a book, play, or piece of music
senses.definitionCN: 书籍、戏剧或乐曲的简化或缩短版本
senses.example: She read a reduction of the novel for the school performance.
senses.exampleCN: 她为学校演出读了这个长篇小说的缩写本。
senses.why: Bringing a long work down to fewer pages is another kind of leading back, from the full text to its essentials.
senses.whyCN: 把长篇作品压到更少的页数，也是一种「引回」：从全文回到要点。

intro.en: Reduction is the noun of reduce, and it carries both the old sense of leading back and the modern sense of a cut.
intro.cn: reduction 是 reduce 的名词，它同时带着「引回」的旧义与「削减」的今义。

items.en: The verb reducere meant to lead back or restore, built on ducere, to lead.
items.cn: 动词 reducere 意为引回或恢复，由 ducere（引导）构成。

items.en: The noun reductio named a leading back, and Latin writers used it for restoring and for reasoning back to a principle.
items.cn: 名词 reductio 指「引回」，拉丁作家用它表示恢复，也表示把论证回溯到某个原理。

items.en: English borrowed the noun through French and kept the sense of a bringing back or a lowering.
items.cn: 英语经由法语借入这个名词，保留了「带回」或「压低」的意思。

items.en: Trade and household use made the price cut the most familiar sense of the word.
items.cn: 商业与家庭的使用让「降价」成为这个词最熟悉的含义。

items.en: Chemistry kept the older sense in reduction, the removal of oxygen from a substance.
items.cn: 化学把这个较古的意义保留在 reduction 中，指从物质中夺去氧。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers nouns from the same ducere family; the near-meaning group gathers words for a fall or a discount.
note.cn: 形近组收同一 ducere 词族的名词；近义组收表示下降或折扣的词。

entries.definition: The process of bringing something about.
A reduction in spending or staff.
A fall in level or amount.

normalIntro.en: The noun is the drop itself: what the verb brings down, the noun names as a fall.
normalIntro.cn: 这个名词就是「下降」本身：动词把东西压下去，名词把这次下压叫作一次跌落。

normal.en: Reduce is the act, reduction is the result you can measure.
normal.cn: reduce 是动作，reduction 是量得出来的结果。

normal.en: A price reduction is a cut that shoppers welcome.
normal.cn: price reduction 是顾客欢迎的降价。

normal.en: A staff reduction is a cut that workers fear.
normal.cn: staff reduction 是员工害怕的裁员。

normal.en: A reduction of ten per cent leaves ninety per cent behind.
normal.cn: 减少一成，就还剩九成。

normal.en: The suffix tion turns the verb of cutting into the thing cut.
normal.cn: 后缀 tion 把「削减」的动词变成被削减的那件事。

abstract.en: Every reduction is a decision about what a thing can do without.
abstract.cn: 每一次削减，都是在决定一件事物没有哪一部分也能成立。

abstract.en: A discount is a reduction that somebody chooses to give.
abstract.cn: 折扣是有人主动给出的减少。

abstract.en: A shortened book is a reduction that keeps the shape and loses the weight.
abstract.cn: 缩写本是一种保住形状、去掉重量的减少。

examples.en: A sharp reduction in staff followed the merger.
examples.cn: 合并之后人手大幅削减。

examples.en: The store advertised a reduction of twenty per cent on all winter coats.
examples.cn: 这家店宣传所有冬季外套降价两成。

examples.en: She read a reduction of the novel for the school performance.
examples.cn: 她为学校演出读了这个长篇小说的缩写本。

dict_mnemonic.text: reduce 加 tion：把东西往下压的动作，变成压下去的这个结果，就是「减少」或「降价」。

root: 拉丁 ducere（引导）→ reducere（引回）→ reductio（引回）→ 英语 reduction；与 reduce 同源，形近的 deduction、induction、production 共用 ducere。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a measured drop; the senses move from a fall in amount, to a fall in price, to a work shortened to its essentials.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「可量的下降」；义项从数量下降，到价格下降，再到作品被压到要点。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tag whose old price is struck through and a lower figure written beside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张贴着新价签的旧标签，数字被划掉重写。

branches.en: a smaller payroll
a coat marked down
a thin school edition
a cut felt as loss and as gain
branches.cn: 同一次削减，一方是损失，一方是得到

branches.en: a price tag and a title page

intro.en: A Latin verb of leading takes a prefix of return and a noun ending, and the noun names the distance something has been brought down.
intro.cn: 拉丁语的「引导」动词接上表返回的前缀与名词词尾，名词便表示某物被压低的那段距离。

latinIntro.en: The base is ducere, to lead, with re- meaning back and -tio forming the noun.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 ducere（引导），re- 表「往回」，-tio 构成名词。

definition_en: to mention or speak about; to consult a source; to send a person or matter to someone else for help or decision
core_image: 一本摊开的旧词典被推到桌子中央
scene: 讨论卡住时，他把手边那本翻旧的词典推到桌子中间。Whenever he is unsure of a word, he refers to the dictionary on his desk.
sceneCN: 这里 refers 是 refer 的第三人称单数，取「查阅」（第 2 个义项：向资料求答案）；句意为每当拿不准一个词，他就查桌上那本词典。画面里可留意：被推到桌中央的旧词典、停下的讨论。

collocations.phrase: refer the matter to the court
refer a patient to a specialist

senses.title: To mention
senses.definition: to speak or write about someone or something briefly
senses.definitionCN: 简短地谈到某人或某事
senses.example: She did not name the source directly but referred to it twice in her talk.
senses.exampleCN: 她没有直接点名消息来源，但在讲话中两次提到它。
senses.why: To refer is first to carry word back: a thing is brought into the conversation without being named outright.
senses.whyCN: refer 首先是「把话带回来」：某件事被带进谈话，却不必直接点名。

senses.title: To consult a source
senses.definition: to look at a book, map, or record for information
senses.definitionCN: 为获取信息而查看书籍、地图或记录
senses.example: Whenever he is unsure of a word, he refers to the dictionary on his desk.
senses.exampleCN: 每当拿不准一个词，他就查桌上那本词典。
senses.why: Looking something up is a carrying back of the answer from the page to the questioner.
senses.whyCN: 查阅就是把答案从书页上带回提问者那里。

senses.title: To send someone onward
senses.definition: to send a person or a problem to another person or body for help or decision
senses.definitionCN: 把人或问题交给另一个人或机构去帮助或裁决
senses.example: The doctor referred her to a specialist in the city hospital.
senses.exampleCN: 医生把她转诊到市医院的专科医生那里。
senses.why: The same carrying back becomes a handing over: the case is passed along, and the first doctor steps aside.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「带回」变成了「交出去」：病例被传给别人，第一位医生退到一旁。

intro.en: Refer belongs to the family of ferre, to carry; the prefix re- turns the carrying round and sends it back to a person or a page.
intro.cn: refer 属于 ferre（携带）这个词族；前缀 re- 把携带的方向转回来，送回某个人或某一页。

items.en: Ferre was the irregular Latin verb to carry or bear, and it lies under many English words of transfer.
items.cn: ferre 是拉丁语中不规则的「携带、承载」动词，许多表示转移的英语词都出自它。

items.en: Referre joined re-, back, with ferre and meant to carry back, report, or bring word.
items.cn: referre 由 re-（往回）与 ferre 组成，意为带回、报告或传话。

items.en: Latin writers used referre for setting a matter down in writing and for referring it to the senate.
items.cn: 拉丁作家用 referre 表示把事情记下来，也表示把事项提交元老院。

items.en: English kept both branches: pointing a reader toward a source, and sending a case to another authority.
items.cn: 英语保留了这两条分支：把读者指向某个出处，以及把案件交给另一个权威。

items.en: The noun reference and the referee who carries the record of a game all descend from the same verb of carrying.
items.cn: 名词 reference，以及负责记录比赛的 referee，都出自同一个「携带」动词。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same ferre family; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of naming, quoting, and consulting.
note.cn: 形近组收同一 ferre 词族的词；近义组收表示提及、引用与查阅的动词。

entries.definition: A mention or a source cited.
An official who judges a game.
The act of sending someone onward.

normalIntro.en: The word is a carrying back: a fact is brought back into the talk, or an answer is brought back from the page.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是「往回带」：事实被带回谈话里，或者答案被从书页上带回来。

normal.en: Re plus ferre, back plus carry: to carry something back into the conversation.
normal.cn: re 加 ferre，往回加携带：把某物带回谈话中。

normal.en: Refer to a book means to carry an answer back from its pages.
normal.cn: refer to a book 指从书页里把答案带回来。

normal.en: If you refer a patient, you hand the case to another doctor.
normal.cn: refer a patient 就是把病例交给另一位医生。

normal.en: Refer takes a double r in the past tense: referred, referring.
normal.cn: refer 的过去式与现在分词双写 r：referred、referring。

normal.en: Reference and referee are the same carrying verb wearing different endings.
normal.cn: reference 与 referee 是同一个「携带」动词换上不同的词尾。

abstract.en: To refer is to trust that a thing is better understood through its source.
abstract.cn: 提及，是相信一件事经由它的出处会更好理解。

abstract.en: A good doctor refers before the case outgrows the room.
abstract.cn: 好医生会在病例超出这间诊室之前把它转出去。

abstract.en: Every reference is a small bridge between a word and the world it points to.
abstract.cn: 每一次指涉，都是词与它所指向的世界之间的一座小桥。

examples.en: She did not name the source directly but referred to it twice in her talk.
examples.cn: 她没有直接点名消息来源，但在讲话中两次提到它。

examples.en: Whenever he is unsure of a word, he refers to the dictionary on his desk.
examples.cn: 每当拿不准一个词，他就查桌上那本词典。

examples.en: The doctor referred her to a specialist in the city hospital.
examples.cn: 医生把她转诊到市医院的专科医生那里。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（往回）加 fer（带）：把话带回来是「提到」，把答案带回来是「查阅」，把人带出去是「转介」。

root: 拉丁 ferre（携带）→ referre（带回、报告、提交）→ 英语 refer；同族有 reference、referee、referral，形近的 prefer、transfer 也共用 ferre，只是前缀各表不同方向。

sensesIntro.en: The core is carrying back; the senses move from bringing a thing into speech, to bringing an answer from a page, to handing a case to another person.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「往回带」；义项从把事物带进谈话，到从书页带回答案，再到把案件交给别人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open, worn dictionary pushed to the middle of a table.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本摊开的旧词典被推到桌子中央。

branches.en: a source named in passing
branches.cn: 被顺带提到的消息来源

branches.en: a finger on a dictionary page
branches.cn: 按在词典书页上的手指

branches.en: a letter sent to a specialist
branches.cn: 寄给专科医生的转诊信

branches.en: a word explained by a page
an answer found and then passed on
branches.cn: 找到答案后再传给别人

intro.en: A Latin verb of carrying takes a prefix of return, and the same stem then grows the noun of a source and the name of an official.
intro.cn: 拉丁语的「携带」动词接上表返回的前缀，同一词干随后又长出表出处的名词与表官员的名称。

latinIntro.en: The base is ferre, to carry; re- sends it back, and the supine relatum supplies the noun forms.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 ferre（携带）；re- 使其返回，动名词词干 relatum 提供名词形式。

items.meaning: one to whom a case is referred

definition_en: a mention of something; a source used for information; a letter about a person's character; the act of citing
core_image: 招聘桌上压着一封封好口的推荐信
scene: 招聘桌前，应聘者把一封封好口的信轻轻递了过去。The manager asked for a reference from her last employer.
sceneCN: 这里 reference 是「推荐信」（第 3 个义项：关于某人品行与能力的证明信）；句意为经理要她提供前雇主写的推荐信。画面里可留意：封好口的信、桌前等待的应聘者。

senses.title: A mention
senses.definition: an act of speaking about someone or something briefly
senses.definitionCN: 简短谈到某人或某事的行为
senses.example: The report makes only one reference to the accident.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告只有一处提到那场事故。
senses.why: A reference is the carrying back of a thing into speech, usually without a full account of it.
senses.whyCN: reference 就是把某件事带回言语中，通常并不作完整的叙述。

senses.title: A source of information
senses.definition: a book, page, or record consulted for information
senses.definitionCN: 为获取信息而查阅的书、页面或记录
senses.example: Keep a reference copy of the map beside the desk.
senses.exampleCN: 在桌边留一份地图备查。
senses.why: The noun can name not only the act of looking but the page that gives the answer back.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词不仅能指「查」这个动作，也能指那页把答案交还给你的资料。

senses.title: A letter about a person
senses.definition: a statement, usually written, about a person's character and ability
senses.definitionCN: 关于某人品行与能力的书面说明
senses.example: The manager asked for a reference from her last employer.
senses.exampleCN: 经理要她提供前雇主写的推荐信。
senses.why: Here a person is carried back to the employer as a report, and the letter is the vehicle of that return.
senses.whyCN: 这里，一个人以「报告」的形式被带回雇主面前，而那封信就是这次带回的载体。

senses.title: To cite as a source
senses.definition: to mention a source in support of a statement, or to provide it with references
senses.definitionCN: 为支持某个说法而提及出处，或为作品加注出处
senses.example: The paper references three studies from the same laboratory.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇论文引用了同一个实验室的三项研究。
senses.why: When the noun turns into a verb, the page is pointed at directly and the carrying back becomes an explicit citation.
senses.whyCN: 当名词转为动词，书页被直接指出来，「带回」也就变成了明确的引用。

intro.en: Reference is the noun of refer: the same carrying back produces a mention, a consulted page, a letter about a person, and a citation.
intro.cn: reference 是 refer 的名词：同一种「往回带」产生了提及、被查阅的书页、关于某人的信，以及引用。

items.en: Referre meant to carry back and to report, built on ferre, to carry.
items.cn: referre 意为带回与报告，由 ferre（携带）构成。

items.en: Late Latin referentia named a relation or a bringing back of one thing to another.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 referentia 指一种关联，或把一物带回另一物。

items.en: French reference entered English as a report or a relation, then widened to written testimony.
items.cn: 法语 reference 以「报告」或「关联」之义进入英语，随后扩展到书面证明。

items.en: By the nineteenth century a reference was commonly a letter that spoke for a job seeker.
items.cn: 到十九世纪，reference 通常指为求职者说话的一封信。

items.en: Modern academic use added the citing of sources, and the verb followed in the twentieth century.
items.cn: 现代学术用法又增添了「引用出处」一义，动词用法则在二十世纪跟进。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words of the same ferre family; the near-meaning group gathers words for a cited source or a spoken mention.
note.cn: 形近组收同一 ferre 词族的词；近义组收表示被引出处或口头提及的词。

entries.definition: An official who judges a game.
A greater liking for one thing.
A quotation or a source named.
A written statement of a person's qualities.

normalIntro.en: The word is the noun of carrying back: a thing is brought into words, a page is brought to the desk, a person is brought to an employer in writing.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是「往回带」的名词：事物被带进话里，书页被带到桌上，人被以书面形式带到雇主面前。

normal.en: Refer is the act, reference is the thing carried back.
normal.cn: refer 是动作，reference 是被带回的那件事。

normal.en: A reference book is one you turn to, not one you read through.
normal.cn: reference book 是拿来查的，不是通读的。

normal.en: A reference letter speaks for you when you are not in the room.
normal.cn: reference letter 在你不在场时替你说话。

normal.en: In reference to means about, in connection with.
normal.cn: in reference to 意为关于、与……有关。

normal.en: As a verb, reference means to cite a source in your text.
normal.cn: 作动词时，reference 指在文中标出出处。

abstract.en: A reference is a promise that the reader can go and check.
abstract.cn: 参考，是对读者许下的「你可以自己去查」的承诺。

abstract.en: A letter of reference turns years of work into one page.
abstract.cn: 推荐信把多年的工作压缩成一页。

abstract.en: Words without references float; references tie them to the ground.
abstract.cn: 没有出处的词语漂浮无根，出处把它们系在地上。

examples.en: The report makes only one reference to the accident.
examples.cn: 这份报告只有一处提到那场事故。

examples.en: The manager asked for a reference from her last employer.
examples.cn: 经理要她提供前雇主写的推荐信。

examples.en: The paper references three studies from the same laboratory.
examples.cn: 这篇论文引用了同一个实验室的三项研究。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（往回）加 fer（带）加 ence（名词尾）：被带回来的东西，可以是提到的话、查的书、荐人的信，也可以是标出的出处。

root: 拉丁 ferre（携带）→ referre（带回、报告）→ 晚期拉丁 referentia → 英语 reference；与 refer、referee、referral 同源，都建立在「带回、交付」这一动作上。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a carried-back thing; the senses move from a word of mention, to a page consulted, to a letter about a person, to a cited source.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「被带回之物」；义项从一句提及，到被查阅的书页，到关于某人的信，再到被标出的出处。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sealed letter lying on a hiring desk.
core.cn: 核心意象：招聘桌上压着一封封好口的推荐信。

branches.en: a passing remark in a report
branches.cn: 报告里顺带的一句提及

branches.en: a map kept open on a desk
a sealed letter from an old employer
a numbered note at the foot of a page
a word explained by the page it points to

intro.en: The Latin verb of carrying takes a prefix of return and a noun ending, and the noun comes to mean both a mention and the proof behind it.
intro.cn: 拉丁语的「携带」动词接上表返回的前缀与名词词尾，名词便同时表示「提及」与「提及背后的凭据」。

latinIntro.en: The stem is ferre, to carry, with re- meaning back and -entia forming the noun.
latinIntro.cn: 词干是 ferre（携带），re- 表「往回」，-entia 构成名词。

definition_en: to remove impurities from a substance; to improve something by small careful changes; to make manners or taste more polished
core_image: 糖浆在铜锅里慢慢熬成雪白的结晶
scene: 糖厂的铜锅冒着热气，浓稠的糖浆被一遍遍撇去浮沫。The plant refines raw sugar before it reaches the shops.
sceneCN: 这里 refines 是 refine 的第三人称单数，取「提炼」（第 1 个义项：除去杂质使物质纯净）；句意为工厂先把粗糖提炼，再送进商店。画面里可留意：冒热气的铜锅、被撇去的浮沫。

senses.title: To purify a substance
senses.definition: to remove impurities from oil, sugar, or metal
senses.definitionCN: 除去油、糖或金属中的杂质
senses.example: The plant refines raw sugar before it reaches the shops.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂先把粗糖提炼，再送进商店。
senses.why: Fine here means pure, and the prefix says the work is done again and again until the last impurity is gone.
senses.whyCN: 这里的 fine 意为纯净，前缀则表示这道工序要反复进行，直到最后一点杂质也被除去。

senses.title: To improve by small changes
senses.definition: to make a method, design, or skill better through careful adjustment
senses.definitionCN: 通过细致的调整使方法、设计或技能更好
senses.example: The team spent a month refining the test before the launch.
senses.exampleCN: 团队在发布前花了一个月改进这项测试。
senses.why: Improving a method is a slow filtering of ideas: each round removes what does not work.
senses.whyCN: 改良方法是对想法进行缓慢的过滤：每一轮都去掉行不通的部分。

senses.title: To make polished
senses.definition: to make manners, taste, or language more delicate and cultivated
senses.definitionCN: 使举止、品味或语言更细腻有教养
senses.example: Years abroad had refined her taste in music.
senses.exampleCN: 多年的海外生活使她的音乐品味变得精细。
senses.why: The same word moves from metal to manners: what is refined has been worked over until the coarse part is gone.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词从金属转到举止：凡被 refined 的东西，都是经过反复打磨，粗陋之处已去。

intro.en: Refine is to make fine: the Latin limit becomes a finish, and repeated finishing removes what is coarse.
intro.cn: refine 就是「使精细」：拉丁语的「界限」变成了「完工」，而反复的精加工去掉了粗糙之处。

items.en: Finis meant an end, a limit, or a boundary, and it grew into words about finishing and fineness.
items.cn: finis 意为终点、界限或边界，由此生长出关于「完成」与「精细」的词。

items.en: French affiner meant to make fine or pure, built on fin, the same root as finis.
items.cn: 法语 affiner 意为使精细或纯净，其词根 fin 与 finis 同源。

items.en: Middle French raffiner added the prefix of repetition to affiner and named the purifying of sugar and metal.
items.cn: 中期法语 raffiner 在 affiner 前加上表重复的前缀，用来指炼糖与炼金属。

items.en: English borrowed the word for purifying substances and soon extended it to improving anything.
items.cn: 英语借入这个词表示提纯物质，很快又扩展到改进任何事物。

items.en: The sense of polished manners grew in the eighteenth century, when taste itself was thought of as something to be refined.
items.cn: 「举止文雅」这一义在十八世纪发展起来，那时品味本身也被视为可以精炼的东西。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the Latin finis; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of purifying and improving.
note.cn: 形近组收由拉丁 finis 构成的词；近义组收表示提纯与改进的动词。

entries.definition: To rub until smooth or to make more elegant.
To develop a taste or skill.

normalIntro.en: The word says make fine: take a coarse thing and work it until only the fine part is left.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词的意思是「使精细」：拿一件粗糙的东西反复加工，直到只剩精细的部分。

normal.en: Re plus fine: to make something fine again and again.
normal.cn: re 加 fine：反复把某物做得更精细。

normal.en: A refinery is the place where crude oil is refined.
normal.cn: refinery 就是原油被提炼的地方。

normal.en: Refine a method means to take out the steps that do not work.
normal.cn: refine a method 指去掉行不通的步骤。

normal.en: Refined sugar is white; refined manners are smooth.
normal.cn: 精炼的糖是白的，文雅的举止是顺的。

normal.en: The noun is refinement, the adjective refined.
normal.cn: 名词是 refinement，形容词是 refined。

abstract.en: Refining is less about adding than about removing.
abstract.cn: 精炼与其说是添加，不如说是去除。

abstract.en: A person is refined by what they have learned to leave out.
abstract.cn: 一个人之所以文雅，在于学会了舍弃什么。

abstract.en: Every craft improves by small refinements no one notices.
abstract.cn: 每一门手艺都靠无人注意的细小改良而进步。

examples.en: The plant refines raw sugar before it reaches the shops.
examples.cn: 工厂先把粗糖提炼，再送进商店。

examples.en: The team spent a month refining the test before the launch.
examples.cn: 团队在发布前花了一个月改进这项测试。

examples.en: Years abroad had refined her taste in music.
examples.cn: 多年的海外生活使她的音乐品味变得精细。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（反复）加 fine（精细）：反复地弄精细，就是提炼杂质、改进方法、打磨举止。

root: 拉丁 finis（界限、终点）→ 法语 affiner（使精细）→ 中期法语 raffiner → 英语 refine；同族有 refinement、refinery，形近的 define、confine、finish 也出自 finis。

sensesIntro.en: The core is making fine; the senses move from removing impurities in matter, to improving a method by small steps, to polishing manners.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「使精细」；义项从除去物质中的杂质，到以小步改进方法，再到打磨举止。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: thick syrup in a copper pan slowly turning into white crystals.
core.cn: 核心意象：铜锅里的浓糖浆慢慢熬成雪白的结晶。

branches.en: white sugar in a paper bag
a test rewritten five times
a quiet, well-chosen compliment
branches.cn: 一句克制而得体的赞美

branches.en: impurities taken out of a process
a sharpened skill and a softened manner
branches.cn: 更精的技术与更柔的举止

intro.en: A Latin word for a boundary turns into a verb of finishing, and the prefix of repetition turns finishing into refining.
intro.cn: 拉丁语中表「边界」的词转成表「完成」的动词，表重复的前缀又把「完成」变成「精炼」。

latinIntro.en: The base is finis, a limit or end, which also gives the Latin verb finire, to finish.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 finis（界限、终点），它也给出拉丁动词 finire（完成）。

definition_en: to throw back light, heat, or sound; to show or express something; to think carefully about
core_image: 静止的湖面把整排山影倒映出来
scene: 清晨湖面没有一丝风，对岸的山被完整地映在水里。The still water reflected the whole line of hills.
sceneCN: 这里 reflected 是 reflect 的过去式，取「反射、映出」（第 1 个义项：把光或影像折回）；句意为静止的水面映出了整排山峦。画面里可留意：没有波纹的湖面、水中的山影。

senses.title: To throw back
senses.definition: to send back light, heat, or sound from a surface
senses.definitionCN: 从表面把光、热或声音送回去
senses.example: The still water reflected the whole line of hills.
senses.exampleCN: 静止的水面映出了整排山峦。
senses.why: The Latin verb is to bend back: a ray meets a surface and is bent away from it, as if the surface refused to keep it.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁动词意为「弯回去」：光线碰到表面后被折开，仿佛表面不肯留下它。

senses.title: To show or stand for
senses.definition: to show the nature or state of something
senses.definitionCN: 显示出某事物的性质或状况
senses.example: The report reflects the concerns of the whole village.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告反映了整个村子的关切。
senses.why: A surface that shows an image is a natural picture of a society that shows its own condition in its records.
senses.whyCN: 能映出影像的表面，自然成了「社会借记录显现自身状况」这一用法的比喻。

senses.title: To think carefully
senses.definition: to turn the mind back on an idea or an experience
senses.definitionCN: 把心思转回到某个想法或经历上
senses.example: She sat by the window and reflected on what he had said.
senses.exampleCN: 她坐在窗边，思考他刚才说的话。
senses.why: Thinking is a bending back of attention: the mind leaves the outer scene and returns to what it already holds.
senses.whyCN: 思考是注意力的折返：心思离开外在景象，回到自己已经拥有的东西上。

intro.en: Reflect is to bend back; the word begins with light and ends with thought, and the path between them is a single metaphor.
intro.cn: reflect 意为「弯回去」；这个词从光开始，到思想结束，而两者之间的路径只是一个比喻。

items.en: Flectere meant to bend or curve, the base of a family of words about turning.
items.cn: flectere 意为弯曲，是表示「转向」的词族的词根。

items.en: Reflectere joined re-, back, with flectere and meant to bend or turn back.
items.cn: reflectere 由 re-（往回）与 flectere 组成，意为弯回去或转回去。

items.en: Natural philosophers used the word first for rays of light bent back from a surface.
items.cn: 自然哲学家最先用这个词指从表面折回的光线。

items.en: By the seventeenth century the same word described an image in a mirror and a mind turned back on itself.
items.cn: 到十七世纪，同一个词既指镜中的影像，也指回转自身的头脑。

items.en: The sense of showing a condition grew from the mirror: a record reflects what produced it.
items.cn: 「显现状况」这一义从镜子发展而来：一份记录会映出产生它的那个东西。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers verbs built on the Latin flectere; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of showing, mirroring, and thinking.
note.cn: 形近组收由拉丁 flectere 构成的动词；近义组收表示映现与思考的动词。

entries.definition: To change the pitch or form of a word.

normalIntro.en: The word is a bending back, whether of light from water or of attention from the world to the self.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是「弯回去」，既可以是水面对光的折返，也可以是注意力从外界折回自身。

normal.en: Re plus flectere, back plus bend: light bends back from the water.
normal.cn: re 加 flectere，往回加弯：光从水面弯回来。

normal.en: A mirror reflects your face; a report reflects the facts.
normal.cn: 镜子映出你的脸，报告映出事实。

normal.en: Reflect on a question means to bend your mind back to it.
normal.cn: reflect on a question 指把心思折回到这个问题上。

normal.en: Reflective people think; reflective surfaces shine.
normal.cn: reflective 的人爱思考，reflective 的表面会反光。

normal.en: Do not confuse reflect with deflect, which turns things aside.
normal.cn: 别把 reflect 与 deflect 弄混，后者是把东西拨到一边。

abstract.en: To reflect is to let what is outside pass through you and come back changed.
abstract.cn: 反射，就是让外界之物穿过你，再以改变过的样子回来。

abstract.en: A society is known by what it chooses to reflect on.
abstract.cn: 一个社会因它选择反思什么而为人所知。

abstract.en: The mirror and the mind use the same verb because both return an image.
abstract.cn: 镜子与头脑共用同一个动词，因为两者都送回一个影像。

examples.en: The still water reflected the whole line of hills.
examples.cn: 静止的水面映出了整排山峦。

examples.en: The report reflects the concerns of the whole village.
examples.cn: 这份报告反映了整个村子的关切。

examples.en: She sat by the window and reflected on what he had said.
examples.cn: 她坐在窗边，思考他刚才说的话。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（往回）加 flect（弯）：光弯回来是反射，事实弯回来是反映，心思弯回来是思考。

root: 拉丁 flectere（弯曲）→ reflectere（弯回去）→ 英语 reflect；同族有 reflection、reflective、reflector，形近的 deflect、inflect、reflex 共用 flectere。

sensesIntro.en: The core is bending back; the senses move from a ray returned by a surface, to a record showing its source, to a mind turned back on itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「弯回去」；义项从表面送回的光线，到映出其来源的记录，再到回转自身的头脑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a windless lake holding the whole line of hills.
core.cn: 核心意象：无风的湖面托着整排山影。

branches.en: hills upside down in water
a report that sounds like the village
a window seat and a long pause
branches.cn: 窗边的座位与长久的停顿

branches.en: an image that tells the truth of its source
a fact seen and then weighed
branches.cn: 看见事实之后加以权衡

intro.en: A Latin verb of bending takes a prefix of return, and the compound passes from rays of light to the movement of thought.
intro.cn: 拉丁语的「弯曲」动词接上表返回的前缀，这个复合词便从光线走到了思想的运动。

latinIntro.en: The base is flectere, to bend, with re- meaning back; the participle reflexus feeds the noun.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 flectere（弯曲），re- 表「往回」；分词 reflexus 供给名词形式。

definition_en: an image thrown back from a surface; something that shows the nature of another thing; careful thought
core_image: 河面上浮出桥与柳树的第二个影子
scene: 风停之后，河面平得像一面镜子，桥和柳树的影子完整地浮在水上。The bridge's reflection lay across the water like a second bridge.
sceneCN: 这里 reflection 是「倒影」（第 1 个义项：表面映出的影像）；句意为桥的倒影横在水面上，像第二座桥。画面里可留意：平如镜面的河、水上的影子。

senses.title: An image in a surface
senses.definition: a picture of something seen in water, glass, or a mirror
senses.definitionCN: 在水面、玻璃或镜中看到的影像
senses.example: The bridge's reflection lay across the water like a second bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 桥的倒影横在水面上，像第二座桥。
senses.why: The noun names the image that a bending-back produces, so the picture and not the act is what we usually mean.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词指「弯回去」所产生的影像，所以我们通常说的是那个画面，而不是那个动作。

senses.title: Something that shows a state
senses.definition: a thing that shows the nature or condition of something else
senses.definitionCN: 显示出另一事物性质或状况的东西
senses.example: The empty streets are a reflection of the fear in the town.
senses.exampleCN: 空荡的街道反映了镇上的恐惧。
senses.why: A surface image becomes evidence: what a society makes is treated as the picture of what it is.
senses.whyCN: 表面上的影像变成了证据：一个社会造出的东西，被当作它自身的写照。

senses.title: Careful thought
senses.definition: quiet and serious thinking about an idea or an experience
senses.definitionCN: 对某个想法或经历的安静而认真的思考
senses.example: On reflection, she decided not to send the letter.
senses.exampleCN: 经过考虑，她决定不寄那封信。
senses.why: The mind bends back to what it already knows, and the noun names both the looking and the image it finds.
senses.whyCN: 头脑弯回到已知之事，而这个名词既指这次回望，也指它找到的那幅图景。

intro.en: Reflection is the noun of reflect; the Latin act of bending back gives both the image in the water and the mind's return to itself.
intro.cn: reflection 是 reflect 的名词；拉丁语中「弯回去」这一动作，既给出水中的影像，也给出头脑向自身的回转。

items.en: Reflectere meant to bend back, built on flectere, to bend.
items.cn: reflectere 意为弯回去，由 flectere（弯曲）构成。

items.en: Late Latin reflexio named a turning back, especially of light from a surface.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 reflexio 指一种折返，尤指光线从表面的折回。

items.en: French reflexion carried the word into English, where it first described light and images.
items.cn: 法语 reflexion 把这个词带入英语，最初用来描述光与影像。

items.en: English long kept reflexion beside reflection, until the Latin spelling won in modern use.
items.cn: 英语长期把 reflexion 与 reflection 并用，直到现代用法中拉丁拼法胜出。

items.en: The sense of serious thinking grew in the seventeenth century from the image of a mind turned back on itself.
items.cn: 「认真思考」这一义在十七世纪由「头脑回转自身」的意象发展而来。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words of bending and returning; the near-meaning group gathers words for an image or for inward thought.
note.cn: 形近组收表示弯曲与折返的词；近义组收表示影像或内省之思的词。

entries.definition: The bending of light passing through a medium.
A picture of a person or thing.

normalIntro.en: The noun names whatever comes back: an image from water, a fact that mirrors a society, or a mind returning to its own question.
normalIntro.cn: 这个名词指一切「回得来」的东西：水面送回的影像，映照社会的事实，或回到自身问题的头脑。

normal.en: Reflect is the act, reflection is the image you see.
normal.cn: reflect 是动作，reflection 是你看到的那个影像。

normal.en: On reflection is a phrase for after you have thought it over.
normal.cn: on reflection 指「经过考虑之后」。

normal.en: A sad street is a reflection of a sad town.
normal.cn: 萧条的街道是一个萧条城镇的写照。

normal.en: Water gives a clear reflection when it is still.
normal.cn: 水面平静时倒影才清晰。

normal.en: The old spelling reflexion still appears in some books.
normal.cn: 旧拼法 reflexion 仍见于一些书籍。

abstract.en: A reflection is the world handed back to you with its left and right exchanged.
abstract.cn: 倒影是世界把它左右互换之后交还给你。

abstract.en: What we build is a reflection of what we believe, whether we say so or not.
abstract.cn: 我们造出的东西映照着我们的信念，无论我们说不说。

abstract.en: Reflection is the cheapest form of improvement.
abstract.cn: 反思是最廉价的改进方式。

examples.en: The bridge's reflection lay across the water like a second bridge.
examples.cn: 桥的倒影横在水面上，像第二座桥。

examples.en: The empty streets are a reflection of the fear in the town.
examples.cn: 空荡的街道反映了镇上的恐惧。

examples.en: On reflection, she decided not to send the letter.
examples.cn: 经过考虑，她决定不寄那封信。

dict_mnemonic.text: reflect 加 ion：被折返回来的东西就是倒影；把事实折回来就是反映；把心思折回来就是沉思。

root: 拉丁 flectere（弯曲）→ reflectere（弯回去）→ 晚期拉丁 reflexio（折返）→ 英语 reflection；与 reflect、reflective、reflector 同源。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a returned image; the senses move from a picture on water, to a fact that mirrors its source, to a mind turned on itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「被送回的影像」；义项从水上的画面，到映照源头的事实，再到回转自身的头脑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a second bridge floating on a river, upside down.
core.cn: 核心意象：河面上浮着一座倒立的桥。

branches.en: a bridge doubled on still water
empty streets that speak of fear
a letter left unsent
an image that proves what it shows
branches.cn: 能证明所映之物的影像

branches.en: a fact weighed before an act

intro.en: A Latin verb of bending takes a prefix of return and a noun ending, and the noun names both the mirrored image and the mirrored thought.
intro.cn: 拉丁语的「弯曲」动词接上表返回的前缀与名词词尾，名词便同时指镜像与「镜中之思」。

latinIntro.en: The base is flectere, to bend, with re- meaning back and -io forming the noun.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 flectere（弯曲），re- 表「往回」，-io 构成名词。

definition_en: to change a system or institution for the better; to make a person abandon bad habits; to form something again
core_image: 会议桌上摊着一份写满批注的税制草案
scene: 会议桌上摊着一份厚厚的税制草案，页边全是红笔批注。The new government promised to reform the tax system within a year.
sceneCN: 这里 reform 是「改革」（第 1 个义项：为改善而改变制度）；句意为新政府承诺一年内改革税制。画面里可留意：厚厚的草案、页边的红笔批注。

senses.title: To change a system
senses.definition: to change an institution or a set of rules in order to improve it
senses.definitionCN: 为改善而改变某个机构或一套规则
senses.example: The new government promised to reform the tax system within a year.
senses.exampleCN: 新政府承诺一年内改革税制。
senses.why: The prefix here really does mean again: the system is given a new form, and what was badly shaped is shaped once more.
senses.whyCN: 这里的前缀确实是「再次」的意思：制度被赋予新的形态，原本畸形的部分被重新塑形。

senses.title: To make a person better
senses.definition: to cause someone to give up wrong habits and live better
senses.definitionCN: 使某人放弃不良习惯、过更好的生活
senses.example: The programme aims to reform young offenders rather than punish them.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目旨在改造年轻罪犯，而不是惩罚他们。
senses.why: A person, like an institution, can be given a new shape; the moral sense treats character as something that can be re-formed.
senses.whyCN: 人和制度一样都能被赋予新的形态；道德义把品性看作可以重新塑造的东西。

senses.title: To form again
senses.definition: to arrange an organization or a body of troops again
senses.definitionCN: 重新编排某个组织或一支部队
senses.example: The surviving soldiers reformed their lines behind the ridge.
senses.exampleCN: 幸存的士兵在山脊后面重新整队。
senses.why: This is the plainest sense: the same prefix, the same verb of forming, with nothing moral added.
senses.whyCN: 这是最朴素的一义：同样的前缀、同样的「成形」动词，没有附加任何道德含义。

intro.en: Reform is forming again; unlike the re- of regime or region, which belongs to a root meaning to rule, this prefix is the ordinary Latin re-, again.
intro.cn: reform 是「重新成形」；与 regime、region 中属于「统治」词根的 re- 不同，这里的前缀就是普通的拉丁 re-，意为「再次」。

items.en: Forma meant shape, mould, or pattern, the source of the whole family.
items.cn: forma 意为形状、模子或样式，是整个词族的来源。

items.en: Formare meant to give a shape to something, or to mould it.
items.cn: formare 意为给某物以形状，或把它塑造成型。

items.en: Reformare joined re-, again, with formare and meant to form once more or restore a shape.
items.cn: reformare 由 re-（再次）与 formare 组成，意为重新成形或恢复形状。

items.en: English first used reform for restoring a church or a practice to an earlier, purer form.
items.cn: 英语最初用 reform 指把教会或某种做法恢复到更早、更纯的形态。

items.en: The political sense of improving an institution by deliberate change became dominant in modern times.
items.cn: 通过有意的改变来改善制度的政治义，在近代成为主流。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers verbs built on the Latin forma; the near-meaning group gathers words for deliberate improvement.
note.cn: 形近组收由拉丁 forma 构成的动词；近义组收表示有意改进的词。

entries.definition: To give a new shape to.
To change a text or law for the better.

normalIntro.en: The word is form plus again: a system, a person, or a line of soldiers is given a new shape.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是 form 加 again：制度、人，或一排士兵，被赋予新的形态。

normal.en: Re plus form: to form a thing again, better than before.
normal.cn: re 加 form：把事物重新塑形，比原来更好。

normal.en: Economic reform reshapes the rules of trade.
normal.cn: economic reform 重塑贸易规则。

normal.en: A reformer is someone who wants the shape changed.
normal.cn: reformer 就是想改变形态的人。

normal.en: To reform a person is to give a bad habit a new shape.
normal.cn: reform a person 就是给坏习惯换一个新的形态。

normal.en: The re- here means again, not the re- hidden inside regime.
normal.cn: 这里的 re- 意为「再次」，不是 regime 里藏着的那个 re-。

abstract.en: Reform is the admission that a shape was wrong and can be made right.
abstract.cn: 改革，就是承认某种形态错了，并且可以改对。

abstract.en: A reform that changes names but not habits is only a new label.
abstract.cn: 只改名字不改习惯的改革，只是一个新标签。

abstract.en: People resist reform because a bad shape is still familiar.
abstract.cn: 人们抗拒改革，因为坏的形态仍然熟悉。

examples.en: The new government promised to reform the tax system within a year.
examples.cn: 新政府承诺一年内改革税制。

examples.en: The programme aims to reform young offenders rather than punish them.
examples.cn: 这个项目旨在改造年轻罪犯，而不是惩罚他们。

examples.en: The surviving soldiers reformed their lines behind the ridge.
examples.cn: 幸存的士兵在山脊后面重新整队。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（再次）加 form（成形）：把制度、把人的品性、把队伍重新排成更好的样子，就是改革、改造、重整。

root: 拉丁 forma（形状）→ formare（使成形）→ reformare（重新成形）→ 英语 reform；同族有 reformation、reformer，形近的 inform、deform、transform 共用 forma。

sensesIntro.en: The core is forming again; the senses move from reshaping rules, to reshaping a person, to reshaping a body of troops.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「重新成形」；义项从重塑规则，到重塑一个人，再到重塑一支部队。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thick tax bill on a table, its margins covered in red notes.
core.cn: 核心意象：会议桌上摊着一份写满批注的税制草案。

branches.en: a tax law rewritten
a young offender given another chance
branches.cn: 得到第二次机会的年轻罪犯

branches.en: soldiers lining up again
rules and a person both reshaped
a character and a line put back in order

intro.en: A Latin word for shape becomes a verb, takes the ordinary prefix of repetition, and gives a new form to anything.
intro.cn: 拉丁语中表「形状」的词先变成动词，再接受表重复的普通前缀，于是能给任何事物以新的形态。

latinIntro.en: The base is forma, shape, with formare to shape and re- meaning again.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 forma（形状），formare 意为使成形，re- 表「再次」。

definition_zh: 使恢复精神；刷新；使重新清晰
definition_en: to make someone feel less tired; to load a page or data again so that it is current; to make a memory clear again
core_image: 树荫下用凉水洗脸的人抬起头，长长呼出一口气
scene: 午后最热的时候，他在树荫下用凉水洗了把脸，抬起头长出一口气。A cold shower refreshed him before the long drive.
sceneCN: 这里 refreshed 是 refresh 的过去式，取「使恢复精神」（第 1 个义项：让人重新有精力）；句意为长途开车前，一个冷水澡让他精神起来。画面里可留意：树荫、凉水、长出的那口气。

pos.zh: 使恢复精神；刷新；使重新清晰

derivatives.zh: 提神的；令人耳目一新的

senses.title: To restore energy
senses.definition: to make a tired person or body feel lively again
senses.definitionCN: 使疲倦的人或身体重新有精神
senses.example: A cold shower refreshed him before the long drive.
senses.exampleCN: 长途开车前，一个冷水澡让他精神起来。
senses.why: The prefix says again and the root says fresh: energy that had gone stale is brought back to its first state.
senses.whyCN: 前缀意为「再次」，词根意为「新鲜」：已经发蔫的精力被带回最初的状态。

senses.title: To load again
senses.definition: to load a page, a screen, or a set of data again so that it shows the latest state
senses.definitionCN: 重新载入网页、屏幕或数据，使其显示最新状态
senses.example: Refresh the page if the table still looks empty.
senses.exampleCN: 如果表格仍然空着，就刷新页面。
senses.why: A screen, like a tired body, holds an old picture; loading it again makes the picture current.
senses.whyCN: 屏幕和疲倦的身体一样，都存着旧的画面；重新载入便让画面变新。

senses.title: To make a memory clear
senses.definition: to bring a fact or a skill back into the mind clearly
senses.definitionCN: 把某个事实或技能清晰地唤回脑中
senses.example: Let me refresh your memory about the rules of the game.
senses.exampleCN: 让我帮你回忆一下比赛规则。
senses.why: A memory that has faded is made fresh again, so the word serves both the body and the mind.
senses.whyCN: 淡去的记忆被重新变新，所以这个词对身心都适用。

intro.en: Refresh is the Latin prefix re- laid on the Germanic word fresh; only the prefix is Latin, the root came to English from its own northern stock.
intro.cn: refresh 是拉丁前缀 re- 加在日耳曼语源的 fresh 上；只有前缀来自拉丁语，词根是从北方语族进入英语的。

items.en: A Germanic word for fresh, lively, or cool lies behind the English adjective.
items.cn: 日耳曼语中一个表示新鲜、有生气或清凉的词，是英语形容词的来源。

items.en: Old English fersc meant fresh, not salt, and it described water and food.
items.cn: 古英语 fersc 意为新鲜的、非腌制的，用来描述水与食物。

items.en: Old French freis reinforced the word with the sense of new and lively.
items.cn: 古法语 freis 以「新的、有生气的」之义强化了这个词。

items.en: Middle English fresh kept both the sense of new and the sense of not tired.
items.cn: 中古英语 fresh 同时保留「新」与「不疲倦」两义。

items.en: In the sixteenth century the Latin prefix re-, again, was added, and refresh meant to make fresh once more.
items.cn: 十六世纪加上拉丁前缀 re-（再次），refresh 便表示「使重新新鲜」。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on fresh; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of renewing strength or data.
note.cn: 形近组收由 fresh 构成的词；近义组收表示恢复精力或更新数据的动词。

entries.definition: Food, drink, or rest that restores.
To bring back to life or strength.
To bring back to a former state.

normalIntro.en: The word is fresh plus again: a tired body, a stale page, or a faded memory is made fresh once more.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是 fresh 加 again：疲倦的身体、过时的页面、淡去的记忆，都被重新变新。

normal.en: Re plus fresh: to make fresh again.
normal.cn: re 加 fresh：使重新变新鲜。

normal.en: A cool drink refreshes you on a hot day.
normal.cn: 大热天一杯冷饮让你精神一振。

normal.en: Press the button to refresh the page.
normal.cn: 按这个按钮刷新页面。

normal.en: Refresh your memory means to look the facts up again.
normal.cn: refresh your memory 指把事实再查一遍。

normal.en: The adjective refreshing describes what gives you this lift.
normal.cn: 形容词 refreshing 描述给你这种提振的东西。

abstract.en: Refreshment is not always rest; sometimes it is a change of work.
abstract.cn: 恢复精神未必靠休息，有时靠换一件工作。

abstract.en: A page reloads, but a mind needs more than a button.
abstract.cn: 页面可以重载，头脑却需要一个按钮之外的东西。

abstract.en: What refreshes a person is whatever returns them to their first energy.
abstract.cn: 能让人 refresh 的，是把他带回最初精力的东西。

examples.en: A cold shower refreshed him before the long drive.
examples.cn: 长途开车前，一个冷水澡让他精神起来。

examples.en: Refresh the page if the table still looks empty.
examples.cn: 如果表格仍然空着，就刷新页面。

examples.en: Let me refresh your memory about the rules of the game.
examples.cn: 让我帮你回忆一下比赛规则。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（再次）加 fresh（新鲜）：让身体再新鲜一次是提神，让页面再新鲜一次是刷新，让记忆再新鲜一次是想起来。

root: 拉丁前缀 re-（再次）＋ 日耳曼语源 fresh（新鲜，古英语 fersc）→ 英语 refresh；词根不是拉丁语，因此本词的拉丁条目只收前缀。同族有 refreshment、refreshing、refresher。

sensesIntro.en: The core is making fresh again; the senses move from a tired body, to a stale screen, to a faded memory.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「使重新新鲜」；义项从疲倦的身体，到过时的屏幕，再到淡去的记忆。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a man lifting his wet face in the shade, breathing out slowly.
core.cn: 核心意象：树荫下用凉水洗脸后抬起头、缓缓呼气的人。

branches.en: a cold shower before a drive
a page loaded a second time
rules brought back to mind
a body and a memory both woken
branches.cn: 身体与记忆同时被唤醒

branches.en: data renewed as energy is renewed
branches.cn: 数据更新如同精力恢复

intro.en: A Latin prefix of repetition meets a Germanic adjective of freshness, and the compound means to make fresh once more.
intro.cn: 拉丁语表重复的前缀遇上日耳曼语表新鲜的形容词，合成词便表示「使重新新鲜」。

latinIntro.en: Only re- is Latin here; fresh descends from Old English fersc, so no Latin root entry is listed.
latinIntro.cn: 这里只有 re- 来自拉丁语；fresh 源自古英语 fersc，因此不列拉丁词根条目。

definition_en: a machine or cabinet that keeps food cold; a large cooling apparatus for storage
core_image: 厨房角落里嗡嗡作响的白色机器，门上贴满便签
scene: 厨房角落那台白色的机器整夜嗡嗡作响，门上贴着孩子的画和几张便签。She kept the milk in the refrigerator overnight.
sceneCN: 这里 refrigerator 是「冰箱」（第 1 个义项：家用冷藏电器）；句意为她把牛奶放在冰箱里过夜。画面里可留意：白色机器、门上的画与便签、夜里的嗡鸣。

senses.title: A kitchen appliance
senses.definition: a household cabinet, usually electric, that keeps food cold
senses.definitionCN: 通常用电的、使食物保持低温的家用箱柜
senses.example: She kept the milk in the refrigerator overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 她把牛奶放在冰箱里过夜。
senses.why: The Latin name is simply a thing that makes cold, and the kitchen cabinet is the most familiar such thing.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁名称的意思就是「使冷的东西」，而厨房里的箱柜是最为人熟悉的那一个。

senses.title: A large cooling unit
senses.definition: a large machine or room used to keep goods cold in shops or industry
senses.definitionCN: 商店或工业中用来使货物保持低温的大型机器或房间
senses.example: The fish was stored in a walk-in refrigerator behind the shop.
senses.exampleCN: 鱼存放在店后的大型冷藏库里。
senses.why: The same word serves the home and the trade: both are boxes where cold is made and held.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词家用与商用都管：两者都是制造并保持低温的箱子。

intro.en: Refrigerator is a modern Latin name built from the verb to cool: it means the thing that makes cold.
intro.cn: refrigerator 是用「使冷」的动词构成的近代拉丁名称，意思就是「使冷的东西」。

items.en: Frigus meant cold, and it is the source of the whole family.
items.cn: frigus 意为寒冷，是整个词族的来源。

items.en: Frigerare meant to cool something, built on frigus.
items.cn: frigerare 意为使某物变冷，由 frigus 构成。

items.en: Refrigerare added re- and meant to cool down or refresh, often of fevered patients.
items.cn: refrigerare 加上 re-，意为使冷却或使清爽，常用于发热的病人。

items.en: Writers of the nineteenth century formed refrigerator from the verb and the ending -ator, one that does.
items.cn: 十九世纪的写作者用该动词加词尾 -ator（做某事者）造出 refrigerator。

items.en: English applied the name to the ice box, and later to the electric cabinet in every kitchen.
items.cn: 英语先用它指冰柜，后来又指每间厨房里的电动箱柜。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same cooling family; the near-meaning group gathers names for cold storage.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「制冷」词族的词；近义组收表冷藏器具的名称。

entries.definition: A compartment or machine for freezing food.
A container that keeps things cool.
An old-fashioned box cooled with ice.

normalIntro.en: The word is literally a cold-maker: a box that produces and holds cold so that food lasts.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词字面上就是「造冷者」：一个制造并保持低温、让食物放得更久的箱子。

normal.en: Frigus is cold, and the machine is the thing that makes cold.
normal.cn: frigus 是寒冷，而这台机器就是造冷的东西。

normal.en: Refrigerate the milk, and the refrigerator keeps it cold.
normal.cn: 把牛奶冷藏，冰箱就让它保持低温。

normal.en: The ending ator marks the doer, as in elevator and generator.
normal.cn: 词尾 ator 标记「做某事者」，如 elevator 与 generator。

normal.en: A walk-in refrigerator is big enough to walk inside.
normal.cn: walk-in refrigerator 大到可以走进去。

normal.en: Refrigeration is the process; the refrigerator is the box.
normal.cn: refrigeration 是过程，refrigerator 是箱子。

abstract.en: Cold is not created but moved, and the machine only moves it faster.
abstract.cn: 冷并非被造出，只是被搬运，而机器只是搬得更快。

abstract.en: A refrigerator is a promise that tomorrow will taste like today.
abstract.cn: 冰箱是一个承诺：明天的味道会像今天一样。

abstract.en: The same Latin verb once cooled a fever and now cools a bottle.
abstract.cn: 同一个拉丁动词曾给发热者降温，如今给瓶子降温。

examples.en: She kept the milk in the refrigerator overnight.
examples.cn: 她把牛奶放在冰箱里过夜。

examples.en: The fish was stored in a walk-in refrigerator behind the shop.
examples.cn: 鱼存放在店后的大型冷藏库里。

examples.en: Open the refrigerator door and let the cold air out slowly.
examples.cn: 打开冰箱门，让冷气慢慢散出来。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（加强）加 friger（冷）加 ator（做某事者）：专门造冷的东西，就是冰箱。

root: 拉丁 frigus（寒冷）→ frigerare（使冷）→ refrigerare（使冷却）→ 近代拉丁 refrigerator（造冷者）→ 英语 refrigerator；同族有 refrigerate、refrigeration、refrigerant。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a cold-maker; the senses move from the household cabinet to the large cooling room of a shop.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「造冷之物」；义项从家用箱柜，到商店里的大型冷藏库。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white machine humming all night in a kitchen corner, covered with notes.
core.cn: 核心意象：厨房角落里嗡嗡作响、贴满便签的白色机器。

branches.en: milk on a kitchen shelf
a cold room behind a fish shop
the same cold in a home and a trade
branches.cn: 家中与店里的同一种冷

branches.en: a child's drawing taped to the door
a heavy door that seals a room

intro.en: A Latin word for cold becomes a verb of cooling, and the agent ending then names the machine that does it.
intro.cn: 拉丁语中表「寒冷」的词先变成「使冷」的动词，施动者词尾随后命名做这件事的机器。

latinIntro.en: The base is frigus, cold, with frigerare to cool, re- again, and -ator one who does.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 frigus（寒冷），frigerare 意为使冷，re- 表「再次」，-ator 指做某事者。

definition_en: a person who has been forced to leave their country because of war, persecution, or disaster
core_image: 边境营地里排着长队等待热汤的人群
scene: 边境的临时营地里，人们排着长队领取热汤，队伍一直延伸到帐篷后面。Thousands of refugees crossed the border that winter.
sceneCN: 这里 refugees 是 refugee 的复数，取「难民」（第 1 个义项：因战争或迫害被迫离乡的人）；句意为那个冬天成千上万的难民越过了边境。画面里可留意：长队、热汤、帐篷后的队伍。

senses.title: One who flees for safety
senses.definition: a person forced to leave home and country by war, persecution, or disaster
senses.definitionCN: 因战争、迫害或灾难被迫离开家园与祖国的人
senses.example: Thousands of refugees crossed the border that winter.
senses.exampleCN: 那个冬天成千上万的难民越过了边境。
senses.why: The Latin root is to flee, and the ending marks the person who has done the fleeing and is now seeking shelter.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为「逃」，词尾标记的正是那个已经逃出、正在寻求庇护的人。

senses.title: One seeking shelter
senses.definition: a person who has left a dangerous place and is looking for protection elsewhere
senses.definitionCN: 离开危险之地、在别处寻求保护的人
senses.example: The church gave shelter to refugees from the flooded valley.
senses.exampleCN: 教堂收留了来自被洪水淹没的山谷的避难者。
senses.why: The word can be used more loosely for anyone in flight, not only for those with legal refugee status.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也可较宽泛地指任何在逃亡中的人，而不只是拥有法定难民身份的人。

intro.en: Refugee names the person at the end of a flight: the Latin verb is to flee, and the noun is the one who has fled and asks for shelter.
intro.cn: refugee 指逃亡终点的那个人：拉丁动词意为「逃」，名词则指已经逃出并请求庇护的人。

items.en: Fugere meant to flee or run away, the base of the family.
items.cn: fugere 意为逃跑或逃走，是这个词族的词根。

items.en: Refugium joined re-, back, with fugere and named a place to which one flees back for safety.
items.cn: refugium 由 re-（往回）与 fugere 组成，指逃回去寻求安全的地方。

items.en: French réfugié named the Protestants who left France in the seventeenth century for their faith.
items.cn: 法语 réfugié 指十七世纪因信仰离开法国的新教徒。

items.en: English borrowed the word and widened it from a religious exile to any person driven out by war or disaster.
items.cn: 英语借入这个词，并从宗教流亡者扩展到任何因战争或灾难被逐出的人。

items.en: International law in the twentieth century fixed refugee as a legal status with defined rights.
items.cn: 二十世纪的国际法把 refugee 固定为一种带有明确权利的法律身份。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words with the same opening syllables; the near-meaning group gathers names for people in flight or in need of protection.
note.cn: 形近组收开头音节相近的词；近义组收表示逃亡者或需受保护者的名称。

entries.definition: An official who judges a game.
One who runs from the law or danger.
One asking a country for protection.
One living away from home by force.
One forced from their home by war.

normalIntro.en: The word ends in ee, the ending for a person, and the stem is to flee: a refugee is the one who fled.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词以 ee 结尾，这是表示「人」的词尾，词干意为「逃」：refugee 就是那个逃出来的人。

normal.en: Fugere is to flee, and a refugee is the person who did it.
normal.cn: fugere 是逃跑，refugee 就是逃的那个人。

normal.en: A refuge is the shelter; a refugee is the one who needs it.
normal.cn: refuge 是避难所，refugee 是需要它的人。

normal.en: A refugee camp is a camp for those who have fled.
normal.cn: refugee camp 是为逃难者设的营地。

normal.en: Political refugees leave because of their beliefs.
normal.cn: political refugees 因信念而离开。

normal.en: Refugee and refuge differ only by the ending of the person.
normal.cn: refugee 与 refuge 的差别只在于那个指人的词尾。

abstract.en: A refugee is a person whose address was taken away.
abstract.cn: 难民，是地址被人夺走的人。

abstract.en: The word asks the reader to remember the road, not only the camp.
abstract.cn: 这个词要人记住那条路，而不只是那个营地。

abstract.en: Shelter is a right, and a refugee is the test of that right.
abstract.cn: 庇护是一项权利，而难民正是这项权利的试金石。

examples.en: Thousands of refugees crossed the border that winter.
examples.cn: 那个冬天成千上万的难民越过了边境。

examples.en: The church gave shelter to refugees from the flooded valley.
examples.cn: 教堂收留了来自被洪水淹没的山谷的避难者。

examples.en: He arrived as a refugee with one bag and no papers.
examples.cn: 他作为一个难民来到这里，只带一个包，没有证件。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（往回、寻庇护）加 fug（逃）加 ee（人）：逃出去寻找庇护的人，就是难民。

root: 拉丁 fugere（逃）→ refugium（避难之地）→ 法语 réfugié（流亡者）→ 英语 refugee；同族有 refuge，形近的 fugitive 也出自 fugere。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a person who fled; the senses move from the legal refugee to anyone seeking shelter.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「已经逃出的人」；义项从法律意义上的难民，扩展到任何寻求庇护的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long line for hot soup in a border camp, running past the tents.
core.cn: 核心意象：边境营地里排到帐篷后面的领汤长队。

branches.en: a family crossing at night
branches.cn: 夜里越过边境的一家人

branches.en: a church opening its doors
the one who fled and the one who shelters
branches.cn: 逃出的人与收留他的人

branches.en: a bag with no papers
a queue that reaches the tents
branches.cn: 一直排到帐篷前的队伍

intro.en: A Latin verb of fleeing takes a prefix of return and a noun ending, and then a person-ending names the one who fled.
intro.cn: 拉丁语的「逃」动词接上表返回的前缀与名词词尾，再由指人的词尾命名那个逃出的人。

latinIntro.en: The base is fugere, to flee; re- means back, and -ium makes a place, while -ee names the person.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 fugere（逃）；re- 表「往回」，-ium 构成表地点的名词，-ee 则指人。

definition_en: the act of saying no to an offer or a request; the act of not granting something
core_image: 合同被推回桌对面，一只手轻轻摇了摇头
scene: 招聘方把合同推回桌对面，摇了摇头，没有多说什么。Her refusal to sign the contract surprised everyone.
sceneCN: 这里 refusal 是「拒绝」（第 1 个义项：表示不接受、不答应）；句意为她拒签合同，让所有人都很意外。画面里可留意：被推回的合同、轻轻摇头的手。

senses.title: The act of saying no
senses.definition: the act of declining an offer, an invitation, or an order
senses.definitionCN: 不接受提议、邀请或命令的行为
senses.example: Her refusal to sign the contract surprised everyone.
senses.exampleCN: 她拒签合同，让所有人都很意外。
senses.why: The noun names the no itself, and the Latin verb behind it images a pouring back: the offer is returned to the one who made it.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词命名的是「不」本身，而其背后的拉丁动词描绘「倒回去」：提议被退回给提出的人。

senses.title: The act of not granting
senses.definition: the act of withholding something that was asked for
senses.definitionCN: 不给予别人所求之物的行为
senses.example: The refusal of a visa left the whole family in limbo.
senses.exampleCN: 签证被拒，让整个家庭悬而未决。
senses.why: When what is turned back is a gift or a permission rather than an offer, the same noun means a withholding.
senses.whyCN: 当被退回的是赠予或许可而不是提议时，同一个名词就表示「不给」。

intro.en: Refusal is the noun of refuse, and its oldest image is a pouring back: what was offered is sent back to its source.
intro.cn: refusal 是 refuse 的名词，其最古老的意象是「倒回去」：被提供的东西被送回原处。

items.en: Fundere meant to pour, and its participle supplied the image of something poured out.
items.cn: fundere 意为倾倒，其分词提供了「被倒出之物」的意象。

items.en: Refusare probably joined re-, back, with the participle of fundere, giving the sense of pouring back and so rejecting.
items.cn: refusare 很可能由 re-（往回）与 fundere 的分词构成，意为倒回去，因而表示拒绝。

items.en: Old French refuser meant to refuse or reject, and English took the verb from it.
items.cn: 古法语 refuser 意为拒绝或驳回，英语由此借入动词。

items.en: English added the noun ending -al and made refusal, the act of the verb.
items.cn: 英语加上名词词尾 -al 造出 refusal，表示该动词的行为。

items.en: In modern use a refusal can be polite or blunt, and the word often carries the weight of a broken expectation.
items.cn: 在现代用法中，拒绝可以是客气的，也可以是生硬的，这个词常带着期待落空的分量。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words that begin like refuse; the near-meaning group gathers nouns for saying no.
note.cn: 形近组收与 refuse 开头相近的词；近义组收表示「说不」的名词。

entries.definition: A statement that something is not true or not granted.
The act of refusing to accept.

normalIntro.en: The noun is a no made into a thing: an offer comes to the table and is pushed back.
normalIntro.cn: 这个名词是把「不」变成一件东西：提议来到桌前，又被推了回去。
