normal.en: Refuse is the act, refusal is the no itself.
normal.cn: refuse 是动作，refusal 是那个「不」本身。

normal.en: A blunt refusal leaves no room for argument.
normal.cn: a blunt refusal 不留争辩的余地。

normal.en: Refusal to comply with the order brought a fine.
normal.cn: 拒绝服从命令招来了罚款。

normal.en: The refusal of a visa is a no written on paper.
normal.cn: 签证被拒，是写在纸上的一声「不」。

normal.en: Refusal ends in al, the ending that turns verbs into acts.
normal.cn: refusal 以 al 结尾，这个词尾把动词变成行为。

abstract.en: A refusal can protect a person as often as it disappoints one.
abstract.cn: 拒绝既能保护一个人，也常让人失望。

abstract.en: The right to refuse is the smallest unit of freedom.
abstract.cn: 拒绝的权利，是自由最小的单位。

abstract.en: A clear refusal is kinder than a slow maybe.
abstract.cn: 明确的拒绝，比拖延的「也许」更善意。

examples.en: Her refusal to sign the contract surprised everyone.
examples.cn: 她拒签合同，让所有人都很意外。

examples.en: The refusal of a visa left the whole family in limbo.
examples.cn: 签证被拒，让整个家庭悬而未决。

examples.en: He met every question with a polite refusal to answer.
examples.cn: 他对每个问题都以礼貌的拒绝作答。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（往回）加 fus（倒）加 al（名词尾）：把递过来的东西倒推回去，就是拒绝；把它变成一件事，就是 refusal。

root: 拉丁 fundere（倾倒）→ refusare（倒回、拒绝）→ 古法语 refuser → 英语 refuse；加 -al 构成 refusal。同族有 refuse、refusable。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a returned offer; the senses move from declining what is offered to withholding what is asked.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「被退回的提议」；义项从拒绝所提供之物，到不给予所请求之物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a contract pushed back across a table with a shake of the head.
core.cn: 核心意象：合同被推回桌对面，一只手轻轻摇了摇头。

branches.en: a signed page left unsigned
branches.cn: 一页没有被签下的合同

branches.en: a visa stamped no
an offer returned and a request denied
branches.cn: 提议被退回，请求被驳回

branches.en: a polite sentence with no room to argue
branches.cn: 一句客气却无可争辩的话

branches.en: a door that stays shut

intro.en: A Latin verb of pouring takes a prefix of return, and a noun ending turns the act of pushing an offer back into a thing with a name.
intro.cn: 拉丁语的「倾倒」动词接上表返回的前缀，名词词尾再把「把提议推回去」这个动作变成有名字的事物。

latinIntro.en: The base is fundere, to pour; re- means back, and -al forms the noun of action.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 fundere（倾倒）；re- 表「往回」，-al 构成表行为的名词。

definition_en: to consider someone or something in a particular way; respect or esteem; to look at steadily
core_image: 老师把一份作业翻看两遍，然后缓缓点头
scene: 老师把那份作业翻来覆去看了两遍，最后缓缓点了点头。The teacher regarded the essay as the best in the class.
sceneCN: 这里 regarded 是 regard 的过去式，取「看待」（第 1 个义项：以某种眼光认为）；句意为老师认为这篇作文是全班最好的。画面里可留意：翻看两遍的动作、缓缓点头。

senses.title: To consider in a way
senses.definition: to think of someone or something in a particular manner
senses.definitionCN: 以某种方式认为某人或某物
senses.example: The teacher regarded the essay as the best in the class.
senses.exampleCN: 老师认为这篇作文是全班最好的。
senses.why: The word begins with a steady look: to regard a thing is first to fix the eyes on it, and then to fix a judgment on it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词始于凝神一看：先让目光落在某物上，再让判断落在它上面。

senses.title: Respect or esteem
senses.definition: a feeling of admiration and careful attention toward someone
senses.definitionCN: 对某人的钦佩与郑重对待
senses.example: The old craftsman is held in high regard by everyone in the town.
senses.exampleCN: 镇上人人都十分敬重这位老匠人。
senses.why: When the steady look carries weight, it becomes esteem: the one who is looked at long is the one who is valued.
senses.whyCN: 当这种凝神注视带上分量，它就变成敬重：被看得最久的人，也是被看重的人。

senses.title: To look at steadily
senses.definition: to look at someone or something with attention, often without speaking
senses.definitionCN: 带着注意看某人或某物，常常不出声
senses.example: She regarded the stranger for a long moment before answering.
senses.exampleCN: 她注视了那陌生人好一会儿才答话。
senses.why: This is the plainest sense, and it keeps the original image of eyes held on a face.
senses.whyCN: 这是最朴素的一义，它保留了「目光停在一个人脸上」的原始意象。

intro.en: Regard is a French word of watching: a Germanic verb of guarding took a French prefix, and English received it as a steady look.
intro.cn: regard 是一个来自法语的「看」的词：日耳曼语的「看守」动词接上法语前缀，英语接收它时意为凝神注视。

items.en: A Germanic verb of watching and guarding lies behind the French word for looking.
items.cn: 日耳曼语中表「看守、注视」的动词，是法语「看」这个词的后盾。

items.en: Old French garder meant to guard or keep, and English kept it as guard.
items.cn: 古法语 garder 意为看守、保留，英语把它保留为 guard。

items.en: Regarder added the intensive prefix re- and meant to look at closely.
items.cn: regarder 加上加强语气的前缀 re-，意为仔细地看。

items.en: English took regard as both a look and a care, and the verb followed the noun.
items.cn: 英语把 regard 同时用作「注视」与「关切」，动词义随后跟上。

items.en: High regard and kind regards grew from the same root: attention paid becomes respect, and respect becomes a greeting.
items.cn: high regard 与 kind regards 出自同一词根：投去的注意变成敬重，敬重又变成问候。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the French verb of guarding; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of judging and looking.
note.cn: 形近组收由法语「看守」动词构成的词；近义组收表示评判与观看的动词。

entries.definition: To think of in a certain way.
To regard in a particular way.

normalIntro.en: The word is a long look: first the eyes rest on a thing, then the mind decides what it is worth.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是一次长久的注视：先让目光停在某物上，再让心思判定它值多少。

normal.en: Regard as means to hold an opinion about something.
normal.cn: regard as 指对某物持某种看法。

normal.en: To regard a person is to look, and to regard them highly is to look up.
normal.cn: regard 一个人是看，regard 得高就是敬重。

normal.en: In this regard is a formal way of saying in this matter.
normal.cn: in this regard 是「在这方面」的正式说法。

normal.en: Give my regards means pass on my greetings.
normal.cn: give my regards 指代我问候。

normal.en: Regardless drops the regard, and carries on without looking.
normal.cn: regardless 丢掉了「看」，不瞧一眼就继续。

abstract.en: How we regard a person decides how we treat them.
abstract.cn: 我们如何看待一个人，决定了我们如何对待他。

abstract.en: To be held in high regard is to be looked at with care.
abstract.cn: 被十分敬重，就是被郑重地看待。

abstract.en: A regard that never becomes action is only a look.
abstract.cn: 从不化为行动的尊重，只是一眼注视。

examples.en: The teacher regarded the essay as the best in the class.
examples.cn: 老师认为这篇作文是全班最好的。

examples.en: The old craftsman is held in high regard by everyone in the town.
examples.cn: 镇上人人都十分敬重这位老匠人。

examples.en: She regarded the stranger for a long moment before answering.
examples.cn: 她注视了那陌生人好一会儿才答话。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（一再）加 gard（看守、看）：一再地看一个人，就是在打量他、评价他、敬重他。

root: 日耳曼语 wardon（看守）→ 古法语 garder（看守）→ regarder（仔细看）→ 英语 regard；re- 在此是加强语气的前缀，词根并非拉丁语，因此拉丁条目只列前缀以外的法语与英语形式。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a steady look; the senses move from forming a view, to holding someone in esteem, to watching silently.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「凝神的注视」；义项从形成看法，到把人放在敬重的位置，再到默默观看。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a teacher reading an essay twice and then nodding slowly.
core.cn: 核心意象：老师把一份作业翻看两遍，缓缓点头。

branches.en: an essay called the best
branches.cn: 被评为最好的一篇作文

branches.en: an old craftsman respected by a town
a stranger watched before an answer
branches.cn: 答话前被注视的陌生人

branches.en: a look that turns into a standing
watching first, judging after

intro.en: A Germanic verb of guarding took a French prefix of intensity, and the compound passed into English as a steady, weighing look.
intro.cn: 日耳曼语表「看守」的动词接上法语中表加强的前缀，这个复合词进入英语，意为凝神而带分量的注视。

latinIntro.en: The stem is the French garder of Germanic origin; re- here intensifies rather than repeats, so no Latin root is listed.
latinIntro.cn: 词干是源自日耳曼语的法语 garder；这里的 re- 表加强而非重复，因此不列拉丁词根。

definition_en: without being affected by something; paying no attention to a difficulty or a warning
core_image: 雨幕中的跑道上，一个人仍按原来的节奏跑圈
scene: 雨越下越大，操场上的人却没有停，仍按原来的节奏跑圈。The team kept training regardless of the rain.
sceneCN: 这里 regardless 是「不管」（第 1 个义项：不受某事影响）；句意为球队不顾下雨，照常训练。画面里可留意：越来越大的雨、没有停下的脚步。

senses.title: Without being affected
senses.definition: in spite of something, without letting it change what happens
senses.definitionCN: 尽管有某事，也不让它改变要做的事
senses.example: The team kept training regardless of the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 球队不顾下雨，照常训练。
senses.why: The suffix means without, and the stem means looking: the word describes a person who does not look at the obstacle.
senses.whyCN: 后缀意为「没有」，词干意为「看」：这个词描述一个不去看障碍的人。

senses.title: In any case
senses.definition: used alone to mean that something will happen whatever else is true
senses.definitionCN: 单独使用时，表示无论其他情况如何某事都会发生
senses.example: The bridge may be closed, but we are going regardless.
senses.exampleCN: 桥也许封了，但无论如何我们都要去。
senses.why: The same ignoring of conditions becomes an adverb of stubborn intent: the plan goes on, rain or no rain.
senses.whyCN: 同样是对条件的无视，转为副词便表示倔强的意图：计划照走，下不下雨都一样。

intro.en: Regardless is regard with a suffix meaning without: it names the attitude of one who does not look at what stands in the way.
intro.cn: regardless 是 regard 加上意为「没有」的后缀：它命名一种不去看阻碍的态度。

items.en: The French verb meant to look at closely, and English shortened it to regard.
items.cn: 这个法语动词意为仔细地看，英语把它简省为 regard。

items.en: Regard kept the sense of a look and of a care, both of which the suffix can cancel.
items.cn: regard 保留「看」与「关切」两义，而后缀能把两者都取消。

items.en: The English suffix -less comes from a Germanic word meaning free of or without.
items.cn: 英语后缀 -less 出自一个意为「没有、免于」的日耳曼词。

items.en: The adjective and adverb regardless appeared in the eighteenth century and spread quickly in speech.
items.cn: 形容词与副词 regardless 出现在十八世纪，并很快在口语中流行。

items.en: The phrase regardless of became the standard way to name a condition that is not allowed to matter.
items.cn: regardless of 这一短语成为表示「不把某条件当作回事」的标准说法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words of looking and not looking; the near-meaning group gathers expressions of ignoring conditions.
note.cn: 形近组收表示「看」与「不看」的词；近义组收表示无视条件的说法。

normalIntro.en: The word says look-less: no looking at the obstacle, so the plan continues as it was.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词说的是「不看」：不看障碍，所以计划照旧继续。

normal.en: Regard plus less: without looking at the thing in the way.
normal.cn: regard 加 less：不去看挡路的东西。

normal.en: Regardless of the weather means the rain will not stop us.
normal.cn: regardless of the weather 指下雨也拦不住我们。

normal.en: Going regardless is a stubborn kind of courage.
normal.cn: going regardless 是一种倔强的勇气。

normal.en: The suffix less cancels the looking in regard.
normal.cn: 后缀 less 取消了 regard 中的「看」。

normal.en: Do not confuse regardless with regardful, which means full of care.
normal.cn: 别把 regardless 与 regardful 弄混，后者意为充满关切。

abstract.en: To act regardless is to decide that a warning will not be a reason.
abstract.cn: 不顾一切地行动，就是认定某个警告不能成为理由。

abstract.en: Some obstacles deserve a look before they are ignored.
abstract.cn: 有些障碍在被无视之前，值得先看一眼。

abstract.en: Courage without regard is often only haste.
abstract.cn: 不顾一切的勇气，常常只是急躁。

examples.en: The team kept training regardless of the rain.
examples.cn: 球队不顾下雨，照常训练。

examples.en: The bridge may be closed, but we are going regardless.
examples.cn: 桥也许封了，但无论如何我们都要去。

examples.en: She applied for the job regardless of her lack of experience.
examples.cn: 尽管缺乏经验，她还是申请了这份工作。

dict_mnemonic.text: regard（看）加 less（没有）：不去看条件与阻碍，就是「不管」「无论如何」。

root: 古法语 regarder（仔细看）→ 英语 regard（看待）＋ -less（没有）→ regardless；词根非拉丁语，因此不列拉丁条目。同族有 regard、disregard、regardful。

sensesIntro.en: The core is not looking at an obstacle; the senses move from an act done in spite of something to the adverb of going on anyway.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「不去看障碍」；义项从不顾某事而行动，到「无论如何也要去」的副词用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a runner holding the same pace while the rain grows heavier.
core.cn: 核心意象：雨幕中的跑道上，一个人仍按原来的节奏跑圈。

branches.en: training in heavy rain
a trip made though the bridge is shut
branches.cn: 桥封了仍要出发的旅行

branches.en: a condition noted and then set aside
branches.cn: 注意到条件之后又把它放到一边

branches.en: a warning that changes nothing
the same pace kept to the end
branches.cn: 一直保持到终点的节奏

intro.en: A word of looking takes a suffix of without, and the compound names the choice not to look at what blocks the way.
intro.cn: 一个表「看」的词接上表「没有」的后缀，合成词便命名「选择不看挡路之物」的态度。

latinIntro.en: The stem regard is French of Germanic origin, and the suffix -less is English; no Latin root is listed.
latinIntro.cn: 词干 regard 是源自日耳曼语的法语词，后缀 -less 属英语，因此不列拉丁词根。

definition_en: a system of government or rule; a set of rules or practices in an institution; a fixed plan of diet or exercise
core_image: 广场墙上的旧标语被新海报一层层盖住
scene: 广场上的广播换了腔调，墙上的旧标语被一层层新海报盖住。The old regime fell after months of protest.
sceneCN: 这里 regime 是「政权」（第 1 个义项：一套统治制度及其政府）；句意为旧政权在数月抗议之后倒台。画面里可留意：换了腔调的广播、被盖住的旧标语。

senses.title: A system of government
senses.definition: a particular government or a system of rule, often one that is strict
senses.definitionCN: 特定的政府或统治制度，常指严厉者
senses.example: The old regime fell after months of protest.
senses.exampleCN: 旧政权在数月抗议之后倒台。
senses.why: The word is built from the Latin verb to rule, and the two letters at its front are not the prefix meaning again but the opening of that root.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由拉丁语「统治」动词构成，词首那两个字母并不是表「再次」的前缀，而是这个词根的开头。

senses.title: A set of rules
senses.definition: an ordered set of rules or practices in an institution or an activity
senses.definitionCN: 某个机构或活动中成体系的规则与做法
senses.example: The new tax regime is simpler for small firms.
senses.exampleCN: 新的税收制度对小公司来说更简单。
senses.why: A government and a tax code are both systems of rule, so the same noun serves politics and administration.
senses.whyCN: 政府与税制都是「统治」的体系，因此同一个名词兼指政治与管理。

senses.title: A fixed daily plan
senses.definition: a strict plan of food, exercise, or treatment followed for health
senses.definitionCN: 为健康而严格遵循的饮食、锻炼或治疗方案
senses.example: Her doctor put her on a strict regime of rest and light exercise.
senses.exampleCN: 医生让她严格遵守休息与轻度锻炼的规律。
senses.why: Ruling a body is like ruling a state: the same noun names a plan that keeps a person in order.
senses.whyCN: 治理身体如同治理国家：同一个名词指一套使人保持秩序的方案。

intro.en: Regime has no prefix meaning again; its first letters belong to the Latin verb regere, to rule, and the word simply names a system of rule.
intro.cn: regime 没有表「再次」的前缀；它开头的字母属于拉丁动词 regere（统治），这个词只是命名一套统治体系。

items.en: Regere meant to rule, guide, or keep straight, and it is the root of a large family of words about order.
items.cn: regere 意为统治、引导或使笔直，是一个关于秩序的大词族的根。

items.en: Regimen, built from regere, meant a rule, a guidance, or a way of managing.
items.cn: 由 regere 构成的 regimen 意为规则、引导或管理方式。

items.en: French régime named a government or a system of rule, and English borrowed it in that sense.
items.cn: 法语 régime 指政府或统治体系，英语即以这个意义借入。

items.en: The older medical use of regimen for a managed way of life passed into regime as a plan of diet and exercise.
items.cn: regimen 较早的医学用法指被管理的生活方式，这一用法传入 regime，成为饮食与锻炼的方案。

items.en: In modern politics the word often carries disapproval, naming a government that others do not accept as legitimate.
items.cn: 在现代政治中，这个词常带贬义，指他方不承认其正当性的政府。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words formed from the same ruling root; the near-meaning group gathers words for government and ordered systems.
note.cn: 形近组收由同一「统治」词根构成的词；近义组收表示政府与有序体系的词。

entries.definition: A fixed plan for health or training.
A military unit; a large group.
The body that rules a state.
The work of managing a system.

normalIntro.en: The word means a ruling order: a government, a code of rules, or a plan that rules a body.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词意为「统治的秩序」：一个政府、一套规则，或一套管住身体的方案。

normal.en: The re in regime is not the re of again; it is the start of the root to rule.
normal.cn: regime 里的 re 不是「再次」的 re，而是「统治」词根的开头。

normal.en: A political regime is a way of ruling a country.
normal.cn: political regime 是统治一个国家的方式。

normal.en: A tax regime is a set of rules about tax.
normal.cn: tax regime 是一套关于税收的规则。

normal.en: A diet regime is a plan that rules your meals.
normal.cn: diet regime 是管住你三餐的计划。

normal.en: Do not read regime as re plus gime; the whole word comes from regere.
normal.cn: 不要把 regime 拆成 re 加 gime，整词出自 regere。

abstract.en: Every regime writes its own history, and every history hides a regime.
abstract.cn: 每个政权都写自己的历史，而每段历史都藏着一个政权。

abstract.en: A regime of rules can protect as easily as it can confine.
abstract.cn: 一套规则既能保护人，也能把人困住。

abstract.en: To keep a body in order is to govern it, and the word knows this.
abstract.cn: 让身体保持秩序就是治理它，这个词明白这一点。

examples.en: The old regime fell after months of protest.
examples.cn: 旧政权在数月抗议之后倒台。

examples.en: The new tax regime is simpler for small firms.
examples.cn: 新的税收制度对小公司来说更简单。

examples.en: Her doctor put her on a strict regime of rest and light exercise.
examples.cn: 医生让她严格遵守休息与轻度锻炼的规律。

dict_mnemonic.text: reg（统治）加 ime：统治一个国家是一套政权，统治一套事务是一种制度，统治身体是一套养生规律。

root: 拉丁 regere（统治、使直）→ regimen（规则、管理）→ 法语 régime → 英语 regime；词首 re 属词根，不是「再次」前缀。同族有 regimen、regiment，形近的 region 也出自 regere。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a ruling order; the senses move from a government, to a body of rules, to a plan that governs a life.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「统治的秩序」；义项从政府，到一套规则，再到管住生活的方案。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: old slogans on a square wall covered layer by layer with new posters.
core.cn: 核心意象：广场墙上的旧标语被一层层新海报盖住。

branches.en: a government losing its square
a tax code in a thin booklet
a daily walk and an early bed
a rule that governs a state and a form
branches.cn: 治理国家与治理表单的同一条规则

branches.en: rules for a country and rules for a body

intro.en: A Latin verb of ruling grows a noun of guidance, and the noun enters English through French as a name for any ruling order.
intro.cn: 拉丁语中表「统治」的动词长出表「引导」的名词，这个名词经法语进入英语，成为一切统治秩序的名称。

latinIntro.en: The root is regere, to rule; regimen is its noun, and the first two letters of regime belong to that root, not to a prefix of repetition.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 regere（统治）；regimen 是它的名词，而 regime 的前两个字母属于这个词根，并不属于表重复的前缀。

definition_en: a large area of land with shared features; an administrative district; a part of a body or of knowledge
core_image: 火车窗外的葡萄园一块接一块向后退去
scene: 火车沿河谷向北，窗外的葡萄园一块接一块向后退去。This region is famous for its wine and its dry summers.
sceneCN: 这里 region 是「地区」（第 1 个义项：有共同特征的一片土地）；句意为这个地区以葡萄酒和干燥的夏季闻名。画面里可留意：向后退去的葡萄园、沿河谷前行的火车。

senses.title: A large area of land
senses.definition: a broad area of a country or the world that shares climate, landscape, or culture
senses.definitionCN: 一国内或世界上气候、地貌或文化相近的广阔地带
senses.example: This region is famous for its wine and its dry summers.
senses.exampleCN: 这个地区以葡萄酒和干燥的夏季闻名。
senses.why: The Latin noun first meant a line drawn to mark a boundary, and then the land inside it.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁名词最初指划出边界的一条线，后来指线内的那片土地。

senses.title: An administrative district
senses.definition: a division of a country made for government or management
senses.definitionCN: 为国家治理或管理而划分的区域
senses.example: The eastern region reports directly to the capital.
senses.exampleCN: 东部行政区直接向首都汇报。
senses.why: A boundary line drawn for rule becomes a unit of rule: the marked land turns into an office with a name.
senses.whyCN: 为统治而划出的界线变成治理的单位：被划出的土地变成了一个有名字的辖区。

senses.title: A part of a whole
senses.definition: a particular part of the body, of the mind, or of a field of knowledge
senses.definitionCN: 身体、心智或知识领域中特定的部分
senses.example: The discovery opened a new region of physics.
senses.exampleCN: 这一发现开辟了物理学的新领域。
senses.why: The idea of a bounded area is carried inward: the mind and a science are also mapped into regions.
senses.whyCN: 「有界的区域」这一观念被转向内部：心智与科学也被划分成区域。

intro.en: Region also begins with the root of ruling, not with a prefix meaning again; a regio was first a boundary drawn, then the land it enclosed.
intro.cn: region 同样以「统治」词根开头，而非表「再次」的前缀；regio 最初是一条画出的界线，随后才是界线内的土地。

items.en: Regere meant to rule or to keep straight, and a line kept straight is the first image of a region.
items.cn: regere 意为统治或使笔直，而一条画得笔直的线，正是 region 的最初意象。

items.en: Regio meant a direction, a boundary line, and then the district marked by that line.
items.cn: regio 意为方向、界线，随后指这条线划出的区域。

items.en: French région carried the geographical sense into English.
items.cn: 法语 région 把地理意义上的用法带入英语。

items.en: English used region for a broad tract of land and for a district of government.
items.cn: 英语用 region 指广阔的地带，也指行政辖区。

items.en: Later uses added parts of the body, fields of study, and the phrase in the region of for an approximate amount.
items.cn: 后来的用法又增添了身体部位、研究领域，以及表示约数的短语 in the region of。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words that resemble region in sound or spelling; the near-meaning group gathers words for a bounded area.
note.cn: 形近组收读音或拼写与 region 相近的词；近义组收表示有界区域的词。

entries.definition: A system of faith and worship.
An administrative part of a town or country.
An area with a particular purpose or feature.

normalIntro.en: The word is a drawn line and the land inside it: first a boundary, then a place with a name.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是一条画出的线以及线内的土地：先是边界，然后是有名字的地方。

normal.en: The re in region is not the re of again; it is the start of the root to rule.
normal.cn: region 里的 re 不是「再次」的 re，而是「统治」词根的开头。

normal.en: A wine-growing region is land that shares a climate.
normal.cn: wine-growing region 是共享一种气候的土地。

normal.en: An administrative region is land drawn for government.
normal.cn: administrative region 是为治理而划出的土地。

normal.en: In the region of fifty means about fifty.
normal.cn: in the region of fifty 意为大约五十。

normal.en: Regional means belonging to such an area.
normal.cn: regional 意为属于这样一个区域的。

abstract.en: A region is made by the line we draw, not by the grass itself.
abstract.cn: 区域由我们画出的线造成，而不是由草本身造成。

abstract.en: Every science is a region with a fence that moves.
abstract.cn: 每一门科学都是一个边界会移动的区域。

abstract.en: To know a region is to know both its borders and its weather.
abstract.cn: 了解一个地区，既要了解它的边界，也要了解它的天气。

examples.en: This region is famous for its wine and its dry summers.
examples.cn: 这个地区以葡萄酒和干燥的夏季闻名。

examples.en: The eastern region reports directly to the capital.
examples.cn: 东部行政区直接向首都汇报。

examples.en: The discovery opened a new region of physics.
examples.cn: 这一发现开辟了物理学的新领域。

dict_mnemonic.text: reg（统治、划直）加 ion：被划出界线的一片土地，就是地区；再往内划，就是身体部位或知识领域。

root: 拉丁 regere（统治、使直）→ regio（界线、区域）→ 法语 région → 英语 region；词首 re 属词根，不是「再次」前缀。同族有 regional、regionalism，形近的 regime 也出自 regere。

sensesIntro.en: The core is bounded land; the senses move from a broad tract, to an administrative district, to a part of a body or a science.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「有界的土地」；义项从广阔地带，到行政辖区，再到身体或学科中的一个部分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: vineyards sliding past a train window, one plot after another.
core.cn: 核心意象：火车窗外一块接一块向后退去的葡萄园。

branches.en: vineyards under a dry summer
an eastern office reporting north
a new chapter in a physics book
a climate and a border on the same map
branches.cn: 同一张地图上的气候与边界

branches.en: land divided for rule and knowledge divided for study
branches.cn: 为治理而分的土地与为研究而分的知识

intro.en: A Latin verb of ruling gives a noun of direction, and a direction drawn on the ground becomes a district with a name.
intro.cn: 拉丁语中表「统治」的动词给出表「方向」的名词，而画在地上的一条方向线，就变成了有名字的辖区。

latinIntro.en: The root is regere, to rule; regio is its noun of direction and boundary, and the re at the front is not a prefix.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 regere（统治）；regio 是它表方向与界线的名词，词首的 re 并不是前缀。
